title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
english: Albania is facing its seventh straight day of violent unrest as students and protesters continue to clash with police in Tirana. Demonstrators are calling for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, citing issues like corruption and poor educational conditions. Hundreds of people, including many police officers, have already been injured as security forces use water cannons and tear gas to control the crowds.

Hiriirtonni kun malaammaltummaa fi haala barnootaa fooyyeessuu dhabuu mormuun, ministirri muummee Eedii Raamaa aangoo gadhiisuu akka qaban gaafachaa jiru. Giddu galeessaan namoota dhibbaan lakkaa'aman fi poolisoonni hedduun miidhamaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, humnoonni nageenyaa bishaan humnaa fi gaazii imimmaaniin hiriirtota bittinneessuuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: Canadian tourist found guilty of animal cruelty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
english: A Canadian man has been convicted of animal cruelty after stealing a flamingo named Peachy from a Las Vegas hotel habitat while intoxicated. The tourist carried the bird to his hotel room, resulting in physical injuries to the animal, despite his claims that the act was intended as a prank. He is now awaiting sentencing and could potentially face up to five years in prison for his actions.
amharic: አንድ የካናዳ ዜጋ በስካር መንፈስ ውስጥ እያለ ከላስ ቬጋስ ሆቴል 'ፒቺ' የተባለች ፍላሚንጎ ወፍ በመስረቁ በእንስሳት ላይ ጭካኔ የተሞላበት ድርጊት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ ተፈርዶበታል። ተከሳሹ ወፏን አንገቷን ይዞ ወደ ሆቴል ክፍሉ በመውሰዱ ወፏ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶባታል። ምንም እንኳን ድርጊቱ ለቀልድ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ጥፋተኛ ብሎታል እናም እስከ አምስት ዓመት እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Namni biyya Kanadaa tokko yeroo machii keessa turetti simbirroo 'Flamingo' jedhamtu kanneen 'Peachy' jedhaman hoteela Laas Veegas keessaa hatuun yakka bineensota irratti raawwatamee irra darbuun himatameera. Namichi kun simbirroo tana qabee gara kutaa hoteela isaa erga galee booda, simbirrottii irratti miidhaan qaamaa gaheera. Innis gochi kun taphaaf akka ta'e dubbatuus, mana murtichaan yakka qabaachuu isaa mirkaneeffatee hidha waggaa shanii hanga ta'u itti murtaa'uu danda'a.

title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
english: Japan has launched the Mars Moons Exploration mission, which aims to collect dust samples from the Martian moon Phobos and return them to Earth. The spacecraft is expected to reach the moon by 2027 to study its origins and terrain using a specialized rover. If successful, this project will provide the first-ever physical samples from the Martian system to be analyzed by scientists in terrestrial laboratories by 2031.
amharic: ጃፓን የማርስ ጨረቃ በሆነችው ፎቦስ ላይ አፈር በመሰብሰብ ወደ ምድር ለማምጣት የታቀደውን የጠፈር ተልዕኮ ወደ ህዋ አስወንጭፋለች። የጠፈር መንኮራኩሯ በ2027 ደርሳ የጨረቃዋን አመጣጥ እና አቀማመጥ ለማጥናት ታቅዷል። ይህ ተልዕኮ በስኬት ከተጠናቀቀ በ2031 የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት በማርስ ጨረቃ ላይ የተገኘ ቁሳቁስን በምድር ላብራቶሪዎች ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የመመርመር እድል ያገኛሉ።
oromo: Japan ergaa gara ji'a maarsi Fooboos jedhamtuutti qajeele qilleensa irra oolcheera, kunis biyyee achirraa fuudhee gara lafaatti deebisuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Xiyyarri kun ji'a kana qorachuuf bara 2027 gahuun kan eegamu yoo ta'u, biyyee funaaname kana gara lafaatti deebisuun ammoo bara 2031 keessa ta'a. Kuni milkaa'inaan yoo raawwatame, saayintistoonni wantoota ji'a maarsi irraa dhufan lafa irratti akka qoratan carraa jalqabaa kenna.

title: Israel’s elections 2026 explained in maps and charts
english: On October 27, 2026, Israel will hold its sixth general election in seven years to select members for the 120-seat Knesset. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is attempting to secure another term amidst ongoing corruption trials and intense regional conflicts. While over seven million citizens are eligible to vote, the process is notable because millions of Palestinians living under Israeli control lack any participation in the system, and forming a stable majority coalition remains a difficult challenge.
amharic: እስራኤል በጥቅምት 27 ቀን 2026 ለ120 መቀመጫ ያለው ፓርላማ ስድስተኛ ጠቅላላ ምርጫዋን ታካሂዳለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በሙስና ክስ እና በክልላዊ ግጭቶች መካከል ለስልጣን ይወዳደራሉ። ከሰባት ሚሊዮን በላይ የሚሆኑ እስራኤላውያን ድምጽ ለመስጠት ብቁ ቢሆኑም፣ በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር የሚኖሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በምርጫው መሳተፍ አለመቻላቸው እና የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምጽ ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ መሆኑ በምርጫው ላይ ትኩረት የሳቡ ጉዳዮች ናቸው።
oromo: Israa'el guyyaa Mudde 27, 2026 palamantii ishee ykn Knesseeti keessatti miseensota 120 filachuuf filannoo waliigalaa ja'affaa gaggeessiti. Namoonni miliyoona torba ol ta'an sagalee kennuuf mirga kan qaban ta'us, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman kan ta'an Falasxiinoota to'annoo Israa'el jala jiran sirna kana keessatti sagalee hin qaban; akkasumas mootummaa ykn ko'alishinii gadi dhaabuun filannoo kana keessatti rakkoo guddaa ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: US Supreme Court to hear case on race in school admissions
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to review a lawsuit involving selective middle schools in Maryland that challenges current admission policies. A group of parents alleges that the school district's selection process discriminates against Asian-American students in favor of Black and Latino applicants. The court will decide whether to revive the case, which was previously dismissed by lower courts that found no evidence of unfair bias.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በመሪላንድ በሚገኙ የተመረጡ መለስተኛ ትምህርት ቤቶች የመግቢያ ደንብ ላይ የቀረበ ክስን ለመመልከት ተስማምቷል። የወላጆች ቡድን የትምህርት ቤቱ የመግቢያ ሥርዓት በእስያ ተወላጅ ተማሪዎች ላይ መድልዎ በማድረግ ጥቁር እና ላቲኖ ተማሪዎችን እንደሚደግፍ ይከራከራሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ቀደም ሲል በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ የተደረገውን ይህንን ክስ እንደገና እንዲታይ ማድረግ አለመደረጉን ይወስናል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa, manneen barnootaa giddu-galeessaa Maryland keessatti qajeelfama galtee barattootaa irratti dhimma ka'e qorachuuf walii galeera. Gareen maatii tokko, sirni galtee mana barnootichaa barattoota gosaa biroo caalaa, barattoota 'Asian-American' ta'an irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira jechuun himata dhiyeessaniiru. Mana murtichaa himata kanaan dura kutaalee mana murtii gadii irraa kufaatii argate kana irra deebi'ee ilaaluu fi dhiisuu isaa murteessa.

title: Japan launches historic mission to bring back Mars moon samples
english: Japan has officially started a five-year space mission aimed at visiting Phobos, one of the moons orbiting Mars. The goal of this uncrewed project is to gather soil samples and safely transport them back to our planet by 2031. This landmark endeavor would represent the first time in history that material from a Martian moon has been collected for scientific analysis.
amharic: ጃፓን ወደ ማርስ ጨረቃ አንዷ ወደሆነችው ፎቦስ የሚደረግ የአምስት ዓመት የጠፈር ምርምር ጉዞ ጀምራለች። የዚህ ያለ ሰው የሚከናወን ፕሮጀክት ዋና ዓላማ የአፈር ናሙናዎችን በመሰብሰብ በ2031 ወደ ምድር መመለስ ነው። ይህ ታሪካዊ ተልዕኮ ስኬታማ ከሆነ፣ ከማርስ ጨረቃ ናሙናዎች ተሰብስበው ለሳይንሳዊ ምርምር ሲቀርቡ የመጀመሪያው ይሆናል።
oromo: Jaappaan gara ji'a maarsii keessaa tokko kan taate 'Foobos' dhaqee qorannoo gochuuf waggaa shan kan turu ergama haaraa jalqabdeetti. Kaayyoon pirojektii namoota hin qabne kanaa, lafa ji'attii kanaa irraa biyyee sassaabanii bara 2031tti gara lafaatti deebisuudha. Ergamaan seena qabeessi kun yoo milkaa'e, yeroo jalqabaatiif biyyee ji'a maarsii irraa sassaabamee qorannoodhaaf gara lafaatti kan fidu ta'a.

title: Fourteen dead in illegal Colombian gold mine collapse
english: At least 14 people lost their lives following the collapse of an unauthorized gold mine in a secluded region of Colombia. Rescue operations have officially ended, leaving several others injured from the incident. Because the site is deep within a rainforest, it is only accessible via air or water travel.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በምትገኝ ገለልተኛ አካባቢ ያለ ህገ-ወጥ የወርቅ ማዕድን በመደርመሱ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው በርካታ ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራውም በአሁኑ ወቅት ተቋርጧል። ቦታው ጥቅጥቅ ባለ ደን የተከበበ በመሆኑ በአውሮፕላን ወይም በጀልባ ብቻ መድረስ ይቻላል።

Haala kanaan namoonni biroon hedduunis miidhamaniiru, akkasumas hojiin barbaachaafi oolchuu gadi dhiifameera. Bakki kun bosona baay'ee keessa waan argamuuf, karaa xiyyaaraa ykn dooniin qofa dhaquun danda'ama.

title: ‘Deliberate’ car ramming of Australian MP an isolated incident, police say
english: Australian independent lawmaker Helen Haines is in critical condition after being intentionally struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta. Police have arrested a 43-year-old man for the attack and stated that there is no broader threat to public safety. While the motive remains under investigation, officials confirmed the collision was a deliberate act rather than an accident.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያዋ የፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ በዋንጋራታ በሚገኘው ቢሯቸው ውጭ በመኪና ሆን ተብሎ ከተገጩ በኋላ በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን ፈጽሟል የተባለውን የ43 ዓመት ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊት የተለየ እና ለህዝብ ተጨማሪ ስጋት የሌለው መሆኑን ገልጿል። ጥቃቱ በአደጋ ሳይሆን ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ መሆኑ የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ የድርጊቱ ዓላማ ግን እስካሁን በምርመራ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Miseensi paarlaamaa Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens waajjira ishee fuulduratti konkolaataan yaadamee rukutamtee gandaa yaalamtuu keessa jirti. Namichi kun maaliif akka kana godhe poolisiin qorachaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, miidhaan isheen irra geesee guddaa ta’uunis gabaafameera.

title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
english: French authorities have introduced nighttime curfews and public gathering bans in Paris and several other major cities following widespread rioting and looting. The protests, which started as student-led demonstrations over school conditions, have resulted in over 2,500 arrests and significant injuries to both protesters and police. In response to the unrest, the government has empowered local mayors to enforce restrictions and is planning to hold those responsible for property damage financially accountable.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ በበርካታ ከተሞች በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ እና ዝርፊያ ሳቢያ መንግስት በፓሪስ እና ሌሎች የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች ላይ የሌሊት ሰዓት እላፊ ገደብ ጥሏል። በትምህርት ቤት ሁኔታዎች መሻሻል ጥያቄ የተጀመረው ተቃውሞ ወደ ሰፊ ብጥብጥ በማደጉ ከ2,500 በላይ ሰዎች ታስረዋል፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የፖሊስ አባላትም ተጎድተዋል። መንግስት በአካባቢው ከንቲባዎች አማካኝነት የሰዓት እላፊ ገደቦችን እንዲያስፈጽም ስልጣን የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ በንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ ግለሰቦችም ካሳ እንዲከፍሉ እንደሚደረግ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Faransaatti jeequmsa fi saamicha babal’ataa dhufeen walqabatee, mootummaan bulchiinsa Paariisii fi magaalota gurguddoo biroo keessatti labsii yeroo galgalaatti daangaa gandaa baaseera. Morman kun jalqaba haala barnootaa fooyyessuuf barattootaan kan eegale yoo ta'u, amma gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun namoonni 2,500 ol hidhamaniiru, poolisonni 1,000 olis miidhamaniiru. Mootummaan magaalota keessatti kantiibonni ofii isaanii fedhii isaaniitiin daangaa kana akka labsan kan heyyame yoo ta'u, miidhaa qabeenyaa ga’eefis namoonni sababa ta’an akka kaffalan taasisus ibseera.

title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
english: The El Niño phenomenon is currently causing severe global weather disruptions, including record-breaking wildfires in Indonesia and an unusually intense hurricane season in the Pacific. Experts note that these extreme events are being worsened by higher ocean temperatures and shifting atmospheric conditions. With the situation expected to persist until at least 2027, many regions are facing significant risks to public health, safety, and infrastructure.
amharic: የኤል ኒኖ ክስተት በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለም ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት መዛባትን እያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በኢንዶኔዥያ የከፋ የደን ቃጠሎ እና በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ደግሞ ያልተለመደ ኃይለኛ የዐውሎ ነፋስ ወቅት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት ክስተቶች በውቅያኖስ የሙቀት መጠን መጨመር እና በከባቢ አየር ለውጥ የተነሳ እየተባባሱ መጥተዋል። ሁኔታው ቢያንስ እስከ 2027 ድረስ ሊቀጥል ስለሚችል፣ ብዙ አካባቢዎች ለሕዝብ ጤና፣ ለደህንነት እና ለመሰረተ ልማት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Mudannoon El Niño yeroo ammaa kana addunyaa guutuu keessatti jijjiirama qilleensa hamaa uumaa jira; kanneen keessaa ibiddi bosonaa Indoneezhiyaa keessatti ka'e fi obomboleettiin Paasifikii keessatti uumame sadarkaa olaana irra ga'eera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, balaawwan kun bishaan galaanaa ho'achuu fi jijjiirama qilleensaan kan walqabatan yoo ta'u, miidhaan isaas hammaataa dhufeera. Haalli kun hanga bara 2027 itti fufa jedhame waan eegamuuf, naannooleen hedduun fayyaa uummataa, nageenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti balaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: ‘Release Epstein files’, protester interrupts JD Vance’s speech
english: During a campaign rally in North Carolina, a protester disrupted US Vice President JD Vance by calling for the disclosure of Jeffrey Epstein’s documents. Vance addressed the interruption with a joke, suggesting the demonstrator was an unauthorized individual who had crossed the border illegally. This occurred while Vance was speaking about immigration policies and border security efforts.
amharic: በሰሜን ካሮላይና በተካሄደ የቅስቀሳ ስብሰባ ላይ አንድ ተቃዋሚ የጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ሰነዶች ይፋ እንዲደረጉ በመጠየቅ የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስን ንግግር አቋርጠዋል። ቫንስ ለዚህ ጥያቄ በቀልድ መልክ ምላሽ ሲሰጡ፣ ተቃዋሚው ድንበር ጥሶ የገባ ሰው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ቫንስ ስለ ኢሚግሬሽን እና ስለ ድንበር ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ንግግር እያደረጉ በነበረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Kaarolayinaa kibbaatti walgahii duula filannoo irratti, namni tokko gadi bahee dokumentiin Jeferi Epistayin akka ifa bahu gaafachuun haasaa Istaayilii Veesi (JD Vance) addaan kutee jira. Veesinis deebii kenneen, namichi kun daangaa cabsee kan dhufe ta'uu danda'a jechuun qoosaniiru. Kunu kan ta'e Veesin waa'ee imaammata godaantotaa fi eegumsa daangaa irratti haasaa gochaa osoo jiranii dha.

title: Rashida Tlaib demands arrest of Israeli soldier linked to Hind Rajab death
english: US Representative Rashida Tlaib is urging the government to arrest an Israeli military commander currently in the United States who is linked to the 2024 death of five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. Tlaib argues that the US is legally obligated to investigate the officer for alleged war crimes based on reports from the Hind Rajab Foundation. The case became a major symbol of the conflict after recordings captured the young girl's desperate plea for help before she and the rescuers sent to find her were killed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አባል ራሺዳ ትላይብ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ የሚገኝ እና እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በጋዛ የ5 ዓመቷን ህጻን ሂንድ ራጃብን በመግደል የተጠረጠረ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አዛዥ እንዲታሰር ጠይቀዋል። ትላይብ አሜሪካ በሂንድ ራጃብ ፋውንዴሽን መረጃ መሰረት ተጠርጣሪውን ለጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ የማቅረብ ህጋዊ ግዴታ አለባት ብለዋል። ህጻኗ ከመገደሏ በፊት ለእርዳታ የጠየቀችበት የድምጽ ቅጂ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን ቀስቅሶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የሲቪል ህዝቦች ለደረሰባቸው ጥቃት ምልክት ሆኗል።
oromo: Miseensi Mana Maree Bakka Buutota Ummata Amerikaa Raashida Tlaayib, ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el kan yeroo ammaa Amerikaa keessa jiru fi bara 2024 Gazaatti mucayyoo waggaa shan Hind Raajab ajjeese jedhamee shakkamu akka hidhamu gaafataniiru. Tlaayib akka jedhanitti, gabaasa 'Hind Rajab Foundation' irratti hundaa'uun, Amerikaan shakkamaa kana yakka waraanaatiin qorachuuf dirqama seeraa qabdi. Mucayyoon tun erga ajjeefamtee booda sagaleen gargaarsa gaafachaa turte addunyaa guututti mufannaa guddaa uumee kan ture yoo ta'u, dhimmi ishees waraana Gaza keessatti sivilonni irratti xiyyeeffannoon raawwatamaa jiruuf mallattoo ta'ee jira.

title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced Israel visit
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel to meet with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. This meeting comes shortly after President Donald Trump publicly endorsed Netanyahu ahead of a highly competitive parliamentary election. While the administration has shown support, Vice President JD Vance clarified that he is not taking a stance on the Israeli vote.

oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Ameerikaa Peet Hegseet gara Israa'el imaluudhaan Muummee Ministiraa Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu waliin walarguufi. Walarguun kun kan ta'e erga Pirezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp filannoo Israa'el dhufuuf jiru irratti Neetaanyaahuun deggaruu isaanii ibsanii booda. Ta'us, Pirezidaant Itti-aanaan JD Vaans dhimma filannoo Israa'el keessa akka hin galleefi gama kamiyyuu akka hin degarre ibsaniiru.

title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded in Uganda
english: Robert Kabera, an exiled Rwandan critic who operated a popular YouTube channel opposing President Paul Kagame, was discovered decapitated in a village near Kampala, Uganda. Ugandan police are actively investigating the murder, while his family suggests the killing was politically motivated by authorities in Rwanda. This incident follows a pattern of suspicious deaths involving Rwandan dissidents living abroad over the past decade.
amharic: የሩዋንዳውን ፕሬዝዳንት ፖል ካጋሜን በዩቲዩብ ቻናላቸው በይፋ ይተቹ የነበሩትና በስደት በኡጋንዳ ይኖሩ የነበሩት ሮበርት ካቤራ አንገታቸው ተቀልቶ በካምፓላ አቅራቢያ ተገኝተዋል። የኡጋንዳ ፖሊስ ግድያውን እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂው ቤተሰቦች ግድያው ከሩዋንዳ መንግስት ጋር በተያያዘ የፖለቲካ ተነሳሽነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ላለፉት ዓመታት በስደት በሚኖሩ የሩዋንዳ ተቃዋሚዎች ላይ ሲደርሱ ከነበሩ ተመሳሳይ ግድያዎች ጋር ተያይዞ ትልቅ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Mormaan mootummaa Ruwaandaa kan ta'anii fi biyya alaatti kan turan Roobert Kaaberaa, qabxiiwwan isaanii YouTube irratti mootummaa Paawul Kaagaamee mormuudhaan beekamu. Reeffi isaanii mataan irraa muramee magaalaa Kaampaalaa, Yugaandaa cinaatti argameera. Poolisiin Yugaandaa ajjeechaa kana qorachaa jiru yoo ta'u, maatiin isaa immoo ajjeechaan kun mootummaa Ruwaandaatiin kan raawwatame ta'uu shakku. Kunis mormitoonni Ruwaandaa biyya alaatti jiraatan gara fuulduraatti yeroo hedduu ajjeefamaa turan keessaa isa tokko ta'eera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US hits Iran hard ‘economically and militarily’
english: President Donald Trump stated that the U.S. is pressuring Iran through both military actions and economic sanctions. Meanwhile, China has criticized the recent U.S.-Israeli strikes as an act of aggression, and Iran has warned that it may disrupt critical underwater communication cables in the Strait of Hormuz in retaliation. Additionally, Trump commended Vladimir Putin for keeping Russia out of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ማሳደሯን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ቻይና በቅርቡ የተካሄደውን የአሜሪካና የእስራኤል ጥቃት እንደ ጥቃት በመፈረጅ አውግዛለች። ኢራን በበኩሏ የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ካልቆመ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ ያሉትን የባህር በታች የቴሌኮም ገመዶች እንደምታጠቃ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee fi waraanaa Iiraan irratti gochuushee itti fufti. Iiraan ammoo, haleellaan kun yoo itti fufe, keebiloota quunnamtii bishaan jala jiran kan galaana Hoormuzi keessa jiran akka barbadeessitu akeekkachiiseetti.

title: Saudi-led coalition in Yemen warns Houthis against smuggling arms through, report of intercepting vessel
english: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen has issued a stern warning to Houthi rebels regarding the illegal transport of military supplies via sea vessels. Officials stated that these smuggling activities pose a significant threat to regional security and have called on local boat operators to stop assisting the group. This announcement followed reports that coalition forces successfully intercepted and destroyed a vessel carrying illicit weapons off the coast of Yemen.

oromo: Gamtaan biyyoota Saudii durfamu kan Yaman keessatti argamu, gareen Huthis meeshaalee waraanaa markabaan seeraan ala akka hin sochoosne akeekkachiiseera. Gochi kun nageenya biyyattii fi naannichaa balaa irra kan buusu ta'uu ibsuun, qabiyyoonni markabootaa garee kana akka hin gargaarre hubachiisaniiru. Kana malees, gamtichi qarqara galaana Yaman keessatti markaba meeshaalee waraanaa fe'atee ture to'annoo jala oolchinee mancaasneerra jedheera.

title: US senator Bernie Sanders slams Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu
english: Senator Bernie Sanders has publicly condemned Donald Trump for supporting Benjamin Netanyahu, claiming this alliance promotes ongoing conflict and suffering in the Middle East. Sanders is urging voters to remove Republicans from power in the upcoming elections to change this trajectory. Furthermore, he is calling for an immediate termination of all military assistance provided to Israel.

oromo: Senator Bernii Saandars deeggarsa Doonaald Tiraamp kan Binyam Neetan yaahuti kennan cimsee balaaleffateera. Saandars tumsi kun naannoo Baha Giddu galeessa keessatti waraanaa fi badii itti fufsiisuu akka danda'u ibsuun, gargaarsi waraanaa Israa'eliif godhamu hundinuu dhaabbachuu qaba jedheera. Kana malees, jijjiirama siyaasaa fiduuf filannoo dhufu irratti paartii Ripabilikaanotaa aangoo irraa kaasuun akka barbaachisu dhaameera.

title: Yemen's Houthis claim six attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia
english: Yemeni Houthi forces recently announced that they launched six separate attacks against targets inside Saudi Arabia. These operations, conducted over a two-day period, involved the use of drones along with both ballistic and cruise missiles. The group claims these strikes are part of their ongoing military campaign.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ስድስት የተለያዩ ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በድሮኖች፣ በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች እና በክሩዝ ሚሳይሎች አማካኝነት ነው። ቡድኑ ጥቃቶቹን ያከናወነው እንደ ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii kan Yemen darban guyyoota lama keessatti biyya Saudii Arabiyaa irratti weerara jaha geggeessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Humni kun weerara kanaaf xiyyoota diroonii, misaa'eloota balistii fi kruz fayyadamaniiru. Gareen kun weerarri kun duula waraanaa isaanii kan itti fufe keessaa tokko ta'uu ibseera.

title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu during unannounced visit to Israel, Axios reports
english: US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth traveled to Israel for an unscripted meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu this Monday. Although the visit was not previously announced, news outlets have confirmed the occurrence of the discussion. Official representatives from the United States and Israel have not provided any public statements regarding the details of the encounter.
amharic: የአሜሪካው መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ ሰኞ ዕለት እስራኤልን ባልታቀደ ጉብኝት ጎብኝተው ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ተወያይተዋል። የዚህ ጉብኝት መደረግ በብዙ የዜና አውታሮች የተረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ በይፋ አስቀድሞ ይፋ አልተደረገም ነበር። እስካሁን ድረስ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ስለ ስብሰባው ዝርዝር መረጃ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Ameerikaa Pit Heegseet Dilbata darbe gara Israa'el imaluun muummee ministiraa Benjaamin Netaanyaahuu waliin mari'ataniiru. Imalli kun duraan kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, miidiyaaleen gurguddoon mariin kun gaggeeffamuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Mootummoonni lamaanuu waa'ee marii kanaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti ibsa kennuu hin barbaanne.

title: Israeli fighter jets spotted over Syria, Iraq, local sources say
english: Local reports indicate that Israeli military aircraft have been observed flying over regions in both Syria and Iraq. The jets were specifically noted in southern and eastern parts of Syria, as well as the Muthanna province in Iraq. These sightings suggest increased aerial activity across these territories.
amharic: የአካባቢው ምንጮች እንደገለጹት የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በሶሪያ እና በኢራቅ ሰማይ ላይ ታይተዋል። አውሮፕላኖቹ በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ እና ምስራቃዊ ክፍሎች እንዲሁም በኢራቅ ሙታና ግዛት ውስጥ እንደታዩ ተዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች የአየር እንቅስቃሴ መጨመሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Maddi oduu naannichaa akka ibsetti, xiyyaarri waraana Israaʼel qilleensa biyyoota Suuriyaa fi Iraaq irra ooluun isaanii mulʼateera. Xiyyaarotni kunneen kutaalee Suuriyaa kibbaa fi bahaa akkasumas naannoo Muthaanaa kan Iraaq keessatti ilaalameera. Gochi kun naannolee kanneenitti sochiin xiyyaara waraanaa dabaluu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
english: Ukrainian tennis player Elina Svitolina has announced her separation from her husband, Gaël Monfils, explaining that the emotional trauma caused by the war in her home country made it impossible to maintain their marriage. She stated that she needs time to heal and rediscover herself, emphasizing that the decision was incredibly difficult. Despite their breakup, the couple intends to continue co-parenting their daughter, Skai, whom they prioritize above all else.
amharic: የዩክሬኗ የቴኒስ ኮከብ ኤሊና ስቪቶሊና በሀገሯ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ባደረሰባት የስነ-ልቦና ጫና ምክንያት ከባለቤቷ ጋኤል ሞንፊልስ ጋር መለያየቷን አስታውቃለች። ስቪቶሊና በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የደረሰባትን የውስጥ ቀውስ ለመቋቋም እና ራሷን ለመፈለግ ይህንን ከባድ ውሳኔ መወሰኗን ገልጻለች። ጥንዶቹ ጋብቻቸውን ቢፈቱም፣ ስካይ ለምትባለው ሴት ልጃቸው የጋራ የወላጅነት ሃላፊነታቸውን እንደሚወጡ አረጋግጠዋል።

Gaa'ela isaanii kan diigan ta'us, mucayyoo isaanii Skai jedhamtu karaa waliin guddifachuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
english: Robert Kabera, a former Rwandan soldier and vocal critic of President Paul Kagame who lived in exile in Uganda, was discovered murdered and decapitated near Kampala. The 50-year-old YouTuber and musician had previously fled his home country citing political persecution. His brutal death has raised significant concerns among other Rwandan dissidents living abroad regarding their personal safety and security.

oromo: Raawwandaa keessaa baqatee Ugaandaa keessa jiraachaa kan ture, loltuu durii fi mormaa pirezidaant Paawul Kaagaamee kan ture Roobert Kaaberaa, magaalaa Kaampaalaa cinaatti mataan isaa muramee du'ee argame. Nama waggaa 50 kanaa fi yeroo baayyee miidiyaa Yuutiyubii irratti yaada isaa ibsaa ture, kanaan dura biyyasaa keessatti ari’atama siyaasaa waan isa mudateef baqatee ture. Ajjeechaan kun baqattota Raawwandaa biyya alaa jiraatan hunda biratti sodaa nageenyaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Egyptian parliament delays vote on military support for Saudi Arabia
english: The Egyptian parliament has postponed its decision on whether to deploy military support to Saudi Arabia following recent attacks by Houthi rebels. Lawmakers delayed the vote until October 26, citing a need for greater clarity regarding the mission's scope, costs, and potential risks. While President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has promised to defend Gulf allies, some political parties are hesitant, demanding more information before approving the deployment.
amharic: የግብፅ ፓርላማ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ከደረሰው ጥቃት ጋር በተያያዘ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ታቅዶ የነበረውን ውሳኔ አስተላልፏል። የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤቱ የውትድርና ተልዕኮውን ዝርዝር ሁኔታ፣ ወጪ እና ስጋቶች በተመለከተ በቂ መረጃ እንደሌለ በመጥቀስ ድምጽ መስጠቱን እስከ ጥቅምት 26 ቀን አራዝሞታል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱልፈታህ አል-ሲሲ የባህረ ሰላጤ አጋሮቻቸውን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ የተወሰኑ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ውሳኔው ከመጽደቁ በፊት ግልጽ የሆነ መረጃ እንዲሰጥ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree Gibxii, haleellaa garee Huutii irratti erga raawwatamee booda waraana Saudii Arabiyaaf gargaarsa gochuun ni danda'ama jedhamee kan eegamu murtee isaa dabarseera. Miseensonni mana maree kun, galii fi balaa waraana kanaa ilaalchisee odeeffannoon ga’aan akka hin jirre ibsuun, murtee isaanii hanga guyyaa Muddee 26tti dabarsaniiru. Prezidaant Abdel Fattah el-Sisi gargaarsa kana kennuuf fedhii kan qaban ta'us, gareewwan siyaasaa tokko tokko ergaa fi baasii waraana kanaa irratti iftoomni akka jiraatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: 160 people reported killed in escalating drone attacks across Sudan
english: Escalating drone attacks in Sudan have resulted in over 160 civilian deaths in recent days, with both government forces and the Rapid Support Forces blamed for the violence. These strikes have targeted markets, transport hubs, and areas housing displaced people, causing widespread destruction and loss of life. The United Nations has formally condemned the strikes, noting that the increased use of unmanned aircraft is causing an alarming surge in civilian casualties and damaging vital infrastructure.
amharic: በሱዳን እየተባባሰ በመጣው የድሮን ጥቃት ባለፉት ጥቂት ቀናት ውስጥ ከ160 በላይ ንጹሃን ዜጎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። ጥቃቶቹ በመንግስት ጦር እና በፍጥነት በሚንቀሳቀሱ የድጋፍ ሃይሎች (RSF) መካከል የሚደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በገበያ ስፍራዎች እና ተፈናቃዮች በሚኖሩባቸው አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ድሮኖቹ በንጹሃን ዜጎች እና በህጻናት ላይ እያደረሱ ያለውን ጉዳት በማውገዝ ስጋቱን ገልጿል።
oromo: Sudan keessatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) guyyoota darban keessa dabalaa dhufeen lubbuun namoota 160 ol darbeera. Haleellaan kunneen waraana mootummaafi garee RSF gidduutti kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan gabaafi iddoowwan namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuudhaan, fayyadamiinsi drone kanneenii lubbuu namoota nagaafi daa'immanii akka galaafataa jiru ibseera.

title: Could your halal pension be funding Israel’s military?
english: Concerns have been raised regarding a Sharia-compliant pension fund managed by HSBC that invested over $100 million into corporations associated with the Israeli military. This discovery has prompted many Muslims to question whether their retirement savings are unintentionally supporting military actions. The situation highlights the challenges of ensuring financial products remain aligned with ethical and religious principles.
amharic: ኤች ኤስ ቢ ሲ (HSBC) የሚያስተዳድረው የሸሪዓ ህግን የተከተለ የጡረታ ፈንድ ከ100 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ዘርፍ ተሳትፎ ባላቸው ኩባንያዎች ላይ ኢንቨስት ማድረጉ አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ይህ ግኝት የሙስሊም ተቀማጮች የጡረታ ገንዘብ ሳያውቁት ወታደራዊ ድርጊቶችን እየደገፈ ይሆን ወይ የሚል ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። ጉዳዩ የፋይናንስ ምርቶች ከሃይማኖታዊ እና ስነ-ምግባራዊ መርሆዎች ጋር ተጣጥመው እንዲቀጥሉ ማድረግ ያለውን ፈተና ያሳያል።
oromo: Baankiin HSBC qabeenya maallaqa sooramaa Shari'aa irratti hundaa'e tokko irratti, biyyoota waraana Israa'el deggaran irratti doolaara miiliyoona 100 ol gubbachuun isaa mormii kaaseera. Dhugaan kunis namoonni Muslimaa maallaqni isaanii osoo hin beekin waraanaaf oolaa jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo keessa akka galan taasiseera. Kunis qabeenyi fi invastimantiin namootaa seera amantii fi safuu wajjin wal simatee deemuu isaa mirkaneeffachuun akka nama rakkisu mul'isa.

title: Israeli police say they arrested 10 in connection with settler attacks
english: Israeli authorities have taken ten individuals into custody following recent violent acts committed by settlers in the occupied West Bank. Among the incidents involving these suspects was an assault on a photographer from the Washington Post and the targeting of European diplomatic staff. Police confirmed the arrests by releasing video footage of the operation.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተፈጸመው የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥቃት ድርጊት ተጠርጥረው አስር ሰዎች በእስራኤል ፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ከተፈጸሙት ጥቃቶች መካከል የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጠኛን መደብደብ እና በአውሮፓውያን ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የተሰነዘረው ጥቃት ይገኙበታል። ፖሊስ የተጠርጣሪዎቹን መያዝ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el qondaaltota fi jiraattota naannawa West Bank irratti haleellaa raawwataniin walqabatee namoota kudhan ta'an to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Shakkamtoonni kun garee suuraa kaasu kan Washington Post miidhuu fi bakka bu'oota dippiloomaasii Awurooppaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaaniitiin himatamu. Poolisiin mallattoo to'annaa jala oolchuu isaanii ibsuuf viidiyoo gadi lakkiseera.

title: Trump approval hits record-low 31 percent, polls show Republican struggles
english: A recent Reuters/Ipsos poll shows President Donald Trump’s approval rating has dropped to a historic low of 31 percent. This decline is largely attributed to economic strain and rising fuel costs following the conflict between the U.S. and Iran. Consequently, the Republican Party is trailing the Democrats by 12 points in general congressional ballot polling ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሮይተርስ/ኢፕሶስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ማለትም 31 በመቶ ወርዷል። ይህ የድጋፍ መቀነስ በዋናነት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተፈጠረው ግጭት ሳቢያ በተከሰተው የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። በዚህም የተነሳ፣ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ከዴሞክራቶች በ12 ነጥብ በልጦ እየተከተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, fudhatamummaan pirezidaant Donald Traamp gara sadarkaa seenaa keessatti mul'ate hin beekne, kan ta'e 31% irratti gadi bu'eera. Gadi bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe waraana Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti ka'een walqabatee rakkoo diinagdee fi daballii gatii boba'aan kan maddu dha. Kana bu'uura godhachuun, paartin Ripaablikaanotaa filannoo giddu-galeessa fuuldura jiruun paartii Demokraatonni irraa dhibbeentaa 12n duubatti hafee jira.

title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
english: Independent Australian MP Helen Haines is in critical condition after being struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta. Authorities have arrested a 43-year-old man at the scene and are investigating the incident as a potential intentional attack. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese condemned the violence, noting that threats against politicians in the country have been increasing.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ በዋንጋራታ በሚገኘው ቢሯቸው ውጭ በመኪና ተገጭተው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በሆስፒታል ይገኛሉ። ፖሊስ የ43 ዓመት አዛውንትን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየመረመረ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንቶኒ አልባኒዝ በፖለቲከኞች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን በመግለጽ ድርጊቱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens waajjira isaanii kan Wangaraataa dura konkolaataan erga isaan buuseen booda miidhaan cimaan irra gahee hospitaala seeraanii jiru. Poolisiin namicha umuriin isaa 43 ta'e to'annoo jala oolcheera, akkasumas gochi kun haleellaa yaadamee ta'uu isaa qorachaa jira. Muummeen Ministiraa Antoonii Albaaniiz haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, biyyattii keessatti siyaasaarratti miidhaan geessisuu fi sodaachisuun dabalaa dhufuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
english: A former OpenAI engineer, Abdulrahman Alfozan, faces charges for allegedly hiding a recording device in a company conference room. US prosecutors claim Alfozan had significant backing from the Saudi government, noting that a military official paid for his family's one-way tickets to leave the country after his arrest. Because high-level meetings occurred in that room, officials argue this case involves national security concerns and that the suspect is a significant flight risk.
amharic: የቀድሞው የOpenAI መሐንዲስ አብዱልረህማን አልፎዛን በኩባንያው የስብሰባ አዳራሽ ውስጥ የመቅረጫ መሳሪያ በመደበቅ ተከሷል። የአሜሪካ አቃቤ ህግ አልፎዛን የሳዑዲ መንግስት ድጋፍ እንደነበረው በመግለጽ፣ ከአሰሩት በኋላ የቤተሰቡ የአንድ አቅጣጫ የበረራ ትኬት በሳዑዲ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን እንደተከፈለ ጠቁመዋል። በስብሰባው ክፍል ውስጥ የከፍተኛ ደረጃ ውይይቶች ይደረጉ ስለነበር፣ ጉዳዩ የሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር እና ተጠርጣሪው ከአገር የመሸሽ ዕድሉ ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Injineerri duraanii OpenAI kan ta'an Abdulrahman Alfozan, kutaa walgahii keessatti meeshaa sagalee waraabu dhoksuun himataman. Abbaan alangaa Ameerikaa akka jedhutti, Alfozan mootummaa Saudii irraa deggarsa guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, erga inni qabamee booda maatiin isaa gara biyya isaaniitti akka deebi'anuf tikkeetiin xiyyaaraa ajajaa waraana Saudiin kaffalameera. Kutaa sana keessatti mariin sadarkaa olaanaa waan taasifamaa tureef, dhimmi kun nageenya biyyaa waliin kan wal qabatu fi shakkamaan kun biyyaa baqachuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Netanyahu’s new security doctrine: Regional strategy or election ploy?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has introduced a new national security strategy that emphasizes preemptive military strikes and stronger regional partnerships. Released shortly before upcoming elections, critics suggest the move is intended to boost his image as a security-focused leader while he faces political instability and corruption charges. Additionally, Netanyahu cited concerns about potential future shifts in US foreign policy as a primary reason for Israel to seek independent, self-reliant defense capabilities.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቅድመ ጥቃት ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እና የቀጠናዊ ትብብርን የሚያጠናክር አዲስ የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ስትራቴጂ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ሰነድ በምርጫ ወቅት የወጣ በመሆኑ ተንታኞች ኔታንያሁ በፖለቲካዊ ችግሮች እና በሙስና ክሶች እየተፈተኑ ባሉበት ወቅት የደኅንነት መጠበቂያ ኃይል ለመምሰል የሚጠቀሙበት ስልት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። በተጨማሪም ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ላይ ለወደፊቱ ሊመጡ የሚችሉ ለውጦችን በመፍራት እስራኤል በራሷ አቅም መከላከል እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaanhuu tarsiimoo nageenya biyyoolessaa haaraa tarkaanfii waraanaa duraa fi walta'iinsa naannawaa irratti xiyyeeffatu ifa godhaniiru. Tarsiimoon kun filannoo dura ba'uun isaa, hayyoonni akka yaadanitti, Netanyaanhuun rakkoo siyaasaa fi himannaa malaammaltummaa keessa utuu jiranuufiif akka gaggeessaa nageenya biyyattiitti of mul'isuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu agarsiisa. Kana malees, Netanyaanhuun gara fuulduraatti imaammata alaa Ameerikaa keessatti jijjiiramni dhufuu danda'u sodachuudhaan, Israa'el humna of danda'een of ittisuu akka qabdu ibsaniiru.

title: Ronaldo banned for 30 days, fined $285 by Portugal over spat with Jesus
english: Cristiano Ronaldo has received a 30-day suspension and a $285 fine from the Portuguese Football Association for abandoning the national team camp. The conflict arose after the star player disagreed with coach Jorge Jesus regarding his playing time during the Nations League. Although Ronaldo has apologized for his actions and left his future with the team open, he must now serve this disciplinary penalty.
amharic: ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ ከብሔራዊ ቡድን ካምፕ በመውጣቱ የፖርቹጋል እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን የ30 ቀናት እገዳ እና የ285 ዶላር ቅጣት ጥሎበታል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው ተጫዋቹ በኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታዎች ላይ በነበረው የጨዋታ ጊዜ ዙሪያ ከአሰልጣኝ ጆርጅ ጄሱስ ጋር ባልተስማሙበት ወቅት ነው። ሮናልዶ ለድርጊቱ ይቅርታ የጠየቀ ቢሆንም፣ የዲሲፕሊን ቅጣቱን ማጠናቀቅ ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Kristiyaanoo Ronaaldoon buufata garee biyyaalessaa gadhiisee waan baheef, federeeshiniin kubbaa miilaa Poorchugaal guyyaa 30f akka inni hin taphanne dhorkuun adabbii dolaara 285 irratti murteesseera. Wal dhabdeen kun kan uumame erga inni taphataa ta'ee irratti leenjisaa Joorj Jeesuus waliin mari'achuu dhabee booda. Ronaaldoon gocha isaa kanaaf dhiifama kan gaafate ta'us, adabbii kana raawwachuun isaa dirqama ta'a.

title: Chuck Schumer urges FCC to block AI robocalls before elections
english: Senate leader Chuck Schumer has asked the FCC to deny a petition that would permit the use of AI-generated robocalls in political campaigns. Officials fear that allowing these deceptive calls could lead to misinformation and voter manipulation during the upcoming midterm elections. This request comes after previous instances where AI technology was used to mimic political figures to discourage citizens from voting.
amharic: የሴኔት መሪ ቻክ ሹመር የፌዴራል ኮሙዩኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን (FCC) በፖለቲካ ዘመቻዎች ውስጥ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም የሚደረጉ ጥሪዎችን እንዲከለክል ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህን አታላይ ጥሪዎች መፍቀድ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ወቅት የተሳሳተ መረጃ እንዲስፋፋ እና መራጮችን ለማሳሳት እንደሚያጋልጥ ስጋት አለ። ይህ ጥያቄ የተነሳው ቀደም ሲል የፖለቲካ ሰዎችን ድምፅ በመኮረጅ መራጮች ድምፅ እንዳይሰጡ ለማደናገር የተሞከረባቸው አጋጣሚዎች በመኖራቸው ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan Senaataa Chaak Shumar komishiniin quunnamtii federaalaa (FCC) duula siyaasaa keessatti sagalee roobootii (robocalls) kan AI fayyadamu akka dhowwu gaafataniiru. Kallattii kanaan waamichi dogoggorsaa ta'e kun filannoo dhufu keessatti odeeffannoo sobaa babal'isuu fi filattoota wallaalchisuu akka danda'u yaaddoon jira. Gaaffiin kun kan dhiyaate, kanaan dura namoonni AI fayyadamuun sagalee nama siyaasaa fakkeessuudhaan filattoonni akka hin filanne gochuuf yaalii godhame booda dha.

title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada
english: Residents of Alberta are voting to determine if the province should initiate a formal legal process to potentially separate from Canada in the future. This move follows significant pressure from activists who feel federal environmental policies are harming the province's oil-based economy, though many locals still prefer to remain part of the country. Provincial leader Danielle Smith organized this vote to allow citizens to voice their opinions, despite strong criticism from Indigenous groups regarding the lack of formal consultation.
amharic: የአልበርታ ነዋሪዎች ግዛታቸው ወደፊት ከካናዳ የመገንጠል ህጋዊ ሂደት እንዲጀምር ድምፅ እየሰጡ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የፌደራል መንግስት የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ፖሊሲዎች የክልሉን ዘይት ላይ የተመሰረተ ኢኮኖሚ ጎድቷል በሚል በሚያምኑ ወገኖች ግፊት ነው። የክልሉ መሪ ዳንኤል ስሚዝ ይህን ድምፅ ያመቻቹት ነዋሪዎች አቋማቸውን እንዲገልጹ ቢሆንም፣ የአካባቢው ተወላጅ ቡድኖች በቂ ምክክር አልተደረገም በሚል ውሳኔውን በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Uummanni Albartaa, naannichi gara fuulduraatti Kanadaarraa gargar ba'uuf adeemsa seeraa jalqabuu qabaa moo hin qabu kan jedhurratti har'a sagalee kennaa jira. Murtii kana kan fidde, imaammanni eegumsa naannoo kan mootummaa federaalaa diinagdee naannichaa kan miidhe ta'uu isaa dubbachuun gareewwan adda addaa dhiibbaa gochuu isaaniiti. Hogganaan naannichaa Daaniyeel Smiit, lammiileen yaada isaanii akka ibsatan carraa kana kan uumte yoo ta'u, gareewwan dhalattoota naannichaa garuu mariin gahaa hin ta'in jedhuun murticha balaaleffachaa jiru.

title: Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death faces verdict
english: A Kenyan judge is currently delivering a verdict for pastor Paul Mackenzie and 29 followers accused of murdering 191 people, mostly children. Prosecutors claim the group forced followers to starve themselves to death under the belief they would meet Jesus. Over 400 bodies were discovered in mass graves within the Shakahola forest, and while the defendants deny these charges, they face additional counts of terrorism and radicalization.
amharic: የኬንያ ዳኛ ፓስተር ፖል ማኬንዚ እና 29 ተከታዮቻቸውን በ191 ሰዎች፣ አብዛኞቹ ሕጻናት፣ ግድያ ወንጀል በተከሰሱበት ጉዳይ ላይ ብይን መስጠት ጀምረዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ቡድኑ ተከታዮቻቸውን ኢየሱስን ለማግኘት በሚል ሰበብ እንዲራቡ አስገድዷቸዋል ሲል ይከሳል። በሻካሆላ ደን ውስጥ ከ400 በላይ አስከሬኖች በተገኙበት በዚህ ጉዳይ፣ ተከሳሾቹ ወንጀሉን ቢክዱም በአሸባሪነት እና በሌሎች ከባድ ወንጀሎች ተከሰው ይጠብቃሉ።
oromo: Abbaan murtee biyya Keeniyaa, namoota 191 kan keessaa baay'een isaanii ijoollee ta'an ajjeesuun himataman keessumtuu lallabaa Paul Mackenzie fi hordaftoota isaa 29 irratti murtee dabarsuuf qophiirra jira. Himatamee jiruun, gareen kun hordaftoota isaanii 'Yesuus argina' jedhanii beelaan akka du'an dirqisiiseera kan jedhuudha. Bosona Shakaholaa keessatti reeffi namoota 400 ol argamuun isaa beekamee, himatamtoonni yakka ajjeechaa kana haaluus, yakka shororkeessummaa fi yakka birootiin himatamuun isaanii gabaafameera.

title: Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut aid to Gaza
english: The World Food Programme is significantly reducing its humanitarian aid in Gaza due to a lack of necessary funding. These cuts will decrease the number of people receiving food support from 1.6 million to 1.1 million and reduce daily hot meal distributions by 100,000. Many displaced families who depend on this assistance will now face even greater challenges in accessing daily food as winter begins.
amharic: የዓለም የምግብ ፕሮግራም አስፈላጊ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እጥረት በማጋጠሙ በጋዛ የሚሰጠውን የሰብአዊ እርዳታ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየቀነሰ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የምግብ ድጋፍ የሚያገኙ ሰዎችን ቁጥር ከ1.6 ሚሊዮን ወደ 1.1 ሚሊዮን ዝቅ የሚያደርግ ሲሆን የዕለታዊ ትኩስ ምግቦችን ስርጭትም በ100,000 ይቀንሳል። በዚሁ እርዳታ ላይ ጥገኛ የሆኑ ተፈናቃይ ቤተሰቦች ክረምት እየመጣ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት ለከፋ የምግብ እጥረት ይጋለጣሉ።
oromo: Sagantaan Nyaata Addunyaa (WFP) gargaarsa baajata dhabuun isaa kan irra gaheef, gargaarsa namoomaa Gaazaa keessatti kennu hir'isuuf dirqameera. Tarkaanfiin kun namoota gargaarsa nyaataa argatan miliyoona 1.6 irraa gara miliyoona 1.1 tti kan gad buusu yoo ta'u, nyaata ho'aa guyyaa guyyaan dhiyaatu immoo kuma 100 ni hir'isa. Maatiin buqqa'anii fi gargaarsa kanaan jiraatan, yeroo ganni dhufaa jirutti rakkoo nyaataa cimaa keessa seenuuf jiru.

title: Personal attacks fire up debate before Brazil's run-off vote
english: Brazil's presidential candidates, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, engaged in a heated debate marked by personal insults rather than policy discussions ahead of Sunday's run-off election. With the polls showing a very tight race, analysts worry that the aggressive nature of the exchange may discourage undecided voters from participating. Despite the tension, the candidates are preparing for a final debate this coming Friday to make their last appeal to the public.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንት እጩዎች ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ፣ እሁድ ለሚካሄደው የሁለተኛ ዙር ምርጫ ቀድመው ባደረጉት ክርክር፣ በፖሊሲ ላይ ከመወያየት ይልቅ በግል ጥቃቶች ላይ ያተኮሩ ንግግሮችን አድርገዋል። የሕዝብ አስተያየቶች ውጤት እጅግ ተቀራራቢ መሆኑን የሚያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ የክርክሩ ጠበኛነት ገለልተኛ መራጮችን ሊያሳዝን ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ሁለቱ ተቀናቃኞች የመጨረሻውን የክርክር ዕድል አርብ ዕለት ይጠቀሙበታል።
oromo: Hirmaattonni filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyya Braazil, Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luula da Siilvaa fi Filaaviyoo Bolsonaaroon, filannoo dhufu kan torbee kanaa dura qophii mormii cimaa fi arrabsoo of keessatti qabate taasisaniiru. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti humni namoota lamaanii wal-qixa waan ta'eef, mormiin kun filattoota irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka fidu shakkiin jira. Dorgomtoonni kunneen marii isaanii kan itti aanu guyyaa Jimaataa akka geggeessan kan eegamu yoo ta'u, kunis carraa isaanii isa dhumaa ta'a.

title: At least 18 killed in Houthi attack on military camp in Yemen’s Shabwa
english: At least 18 people were killed and over 30 injured when Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles at a military training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province. The attack targeted new recruits during a training exercise amidst ongoing civil war tensions. Government officials have condemned the strike as a terrorist act and have vowed to respond firmly against the Houthi movement.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሻብዋ ግዛት በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ ላይ በፈጸሙት የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 18 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ30 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው አዳዲስ ወታደሮች በስልጠና ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ነው። የየመን መንግስት ጥቃቱን አሸባሪ ድርጊት ሲል የገለጸው ሲሆን፣ በሁቲዎች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humni Houthi godina Shabwaa keessatti bakka leenjii waraanaa irratti rukuttaa mizaayilii raawwateen namoonni 18 yoo du'an, 30 ol immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo loltoonni haaraan leenjii irratti turanidha. Mootummaan Yaman haleellaa kana balaaleffachuudhaan, Houthi irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu waadaa galeera.

title: The night watch: Palestinians protecting their homes from settler pogroms
english: Palestinians living in the occupied West Bank are forming community watch groups and installing physical barriers to protect their families from a surge in violent settler attacks. Since October 2023, the frequency of these assaults against homes, property, and individuals has risen significantly, leaving residents feeling abandoned by authorities. Families like Abdul Rahman Jabr’s are now forced to stay awake at night or miss work to personally guard their households against repeated vandalism and destruction.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ከሰፋሪዎች የሚደርስባቸውን የጥቃት አደጋ ለመከላከል የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ቡድኖችን እያደራጁ እና የቤት ደህንነታቸውን የሚያጠናክሩ ግንባታዎችን እያከናወኑ ነው። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በቤቶች እና በንብረቶች ላይ የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ ነዋሪዎች ከባለስልጣናት ምንም አይነት ከለላ እንደሌላቸው ይሰማቸዋል። እንደ አብዱል ራህማን ጃብር ያሉ ግለሰቦች ቤተሰባቸውን ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ በየቤታቸው እየተረባረቡ እና የቀን ስራቸውን ሳይቀር ትተው ሌሊቱን ሙሉ በንቃት መጠበቅ ግድ ሆኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Warri Falasxiin naannoo West Bank jiraatan, miidhaa fi weerara saafaroota (settlers) irraa maatii isaanii ittisuuf jechuun garee ittisaa gurmeessaa fi gamoowwan isaanii irratti tarkaanfii eegumsaa fudhachaa jiru. Sadaasa 2023 irraa eegalee, haleellaan mana, qabeenyaa fi namoota irratti raawwatamu dabaluun isaa, jiraattonni mootummaa irraa eegumsa akka hin qabne akka itti dhagaahamu godheera. Akkuma Abdul Rahmaan Jaabir, maatiin hedduun isaa, sodaa haleellaa kanaa irraa kan ka'e, halkan sa'aatii isaanii guutuu eeguu fi hojii isaanii dhiisanii mana isaanii eeggachuu dirqama itti ta'eera.

title: Al Jazeera investigation challenges Israeli account of Heidi Levine attack
english: A recent Al Jazeera investigation contradicts official Israeli claims regarding an attack on American journalist Heidi Levine and Palestinian farmers in the West Bank. By analyzing verified video evidence and geospatial data, the report shows that masked settlers carried out the assault while nearby Israeli forces failed to intervene and even fired tear gas at those helping the victims. Levine sustained serious injuries, including broken bones, despite wearing protective gear identifying her as a member of the press.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ አዲስ ምርመራ በአሜሪካዊቷ ጋዜጠኛ ሃይዲ ሌቪን እና በዌስት ባንክ ፍልስጤማውያን ገበሬዎች ላይ ስለደረሰው ጥቃት የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የሰጡትን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የተረጋገጡ ምስሎችን እና የመሬት አቀማመጥ መረጃዎችን በመተንተን የተዘጋጀው ሪፖርቱ፣ ጭንብል የለበሱ ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃቱን ሲፈጽሙ በአቅራቢያ የነበሩ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጣልቃ ከመግባት ይልቅ ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለሰጡ ሰዎች የጋዝ ቦምብ መወርወራቸውን ያሳያል። ሌቪን እንደ ጋዜጠኛ መለዮ ለብሳ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በደረሰባት ጥቃት ከባድ የአጥንት ስብራት እና ጉዳቶች አስተናግዳለች።
oromo: Qorannoon Al Jazeera dhiheenya kana bahe, miidiyaan Ameerikaa Heidi Levine fi qonnaan bultoota Falastiin irratti kaayyoo qabamee naannoo West Bankitti raawwatame ilaalchisee ibsa mootummaan Israa'el kenne mormuu isaa ibseera. Ragaalee viidiyoo fi kaartaa lafaa irratti hundaa'uun, qorannichi namoonni fuula isaanii haguugatan haleellaa sana raawwachuu fi loltoonni Israa'el naannicha turan garuu miidhamtoota gargaaruu mannaa, gargaartota sana irratti gaazii imimmaaniin akka weeraran mirkaneesseera. Levine uffata miidiyaa agarsiisu uffattee jirtus, haleellaa kanaan lafee cabuu fi miidhaa cimaa biroo irra gaheera.

title: Qatar to unveil regional defence partnership
english: Qatar has announced plans to launch a new regional defense partnership to improve its military strength. The initiative was revealed by the country's Minister of State for Defence Affairs during the Global Security Forum held in Doha. This move aims to foster greater collaboration and security cooperation among regional neighbors.
amharic: ኳታር ወታደራዊ አቅሟን ለማጠናከር ያለመ አዲስ የክልል የመከላከያ አጋርነት ለመመስረት ማቀዷን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ዕቅድ ይፋ የሆነው በዶሃ በተካሄደው የአለም አቀፍ የፀጥታ ጉባኤ ላይ በሀገሪቱ የመከላከያ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስትር ነው። እርምጃው በክልሉ ውስጥ ያሉ ሀገራትን የፀጥታ ትብብር ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Qatar humna waraana ishee cimsuuf tumsa ittisa naannoo haaraa hundeessuuf karoorfachuu ishee beeksisite. Karoorri kun kan ibsame gumiin nageenyaa idil-addunyaa Doohaatti geggeeffame irratti ministeera ittisa biyyattitiin dha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota naannichaa gidduutti walta'iinsa nageenyaa fi waldeeggarsa caalu uumuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: On Iran, Israel’s opposition is even more hawkish than Netanyahu
english: While Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is often criticized internationally for his handling of Iran, Israel's opposition leaders are actually calling for even more aggressive military action against Tehran. Leading figures like Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Lapid argue that Netanyahu has failed to effectively dismantle Iran's nuclear program or security threats. As the upcoming elections approach, these opposition politicians are promising a more forceful strategy to neutralize Iran's nuclear capabilities.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በኢራን ጉዳይ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ትችት ቢሰነዘርባቸውም፣ የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ከእሳቸው በበለጠ ጠንካራ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ እየጠየቁ ነው። እንደ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት እና ያኢር ላፒድ ያሉ የተቃዋሚ መሪዎች ኔታንያሁ የኢራንን የኒዩክሌር ፕሮግራም ለማስቆም በቂ ጥረት አላደረጉም ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። በመጪው ምርጫም እነዚህ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች የኢራንን ስጋት ለማስወገድ የበለጠ ወታደራዊ ግፊት እንደሚፈጥሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Beenjaamin Neetanyaahu dhimma Iraan irratti addunyaan yoo isaan komatu, mormitoonni Israa'el garuu isaan irra caalaatti tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuu akka qaban gaafachaa jiru. Hoggantoonni mormituu kan akka Gaadii Ayizenkootiifi Ya'iir Laapiid, Neetanyaahu sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan diiguuf ykn dhaabuuf carraaqqii gahaa hin goone jedhu. Filannoo dhiyaataa jiruun walqabatee, paartiileen mormituu kun sodaawwan Iraan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galachaa jiru.

title: Ethiopia’s Intellectual Crisis Begins With a Culture of Conformity
english: Recent discussions highlight an intellectual crisis in Ethiopia, where political fear and a social culture of conformity discourage independent thinking. The article argues that society prioritizes imitation over innovation, training individuals from a young age to remain silent rather than challenge the status quo. To move forward, Ethiopia must foster an environment that values questioning and critical thought rather than just rewarding passive obedience.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ውይይቶች በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ያለውን ምሁራዊ ቀውስ የሚያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ የፖለቲካ ፍርሃት እና የባህል ተፅዕኖ ነፃ አስተሳሰብን እንደሚያዳክም ይጠቁማሉ። ጽሑፉ ማህበረሰቡ ፈጠራን ከመከተል ይልቅ አርአያነትን ወይም መኮረጅን በማስቀደሙ፣ ሰዎች ጥያቄ ከመጠየቅ ይልቅ ዝምታን እንዲመርጡ እንደሚያደርግ ይከራከራል። ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ ማህበረሰቡ ትችትን እና ነፃ አስተሳሰብን የሚያበረታታ አዲስ አቅጣጫ መከተል እንዳለበት ይገልፃል።
oromo: Mariiwwan dhihoo as keessatti gaggeeffaman akka agarsiisanitti, Itoophiyaa keessatti sodaan siyaasaa fi aadaan wal-fakkaachuu yaada bilisaa fi hayyummaa xiqqeessaa jira. Barruun kun, hawaasni keenya uumamaa fi yaada haaraa uumuu caalaa kan darbe hordofuu fi callisee fudhachuu akka gabbate ibsa. Kanaafuu, Itoophiyaan jijjiirama fiduuf yaada bilisaa fi gaaffii gaafachuu kan jajjabeessu hawaasa ijaaruu qabdi.

title: France's government under pressure after weekend of widespread violence
english: The French government is facing a crisis after peaceful protests against the cost of living and poor public services escalated into widespread looting and violence over the weekend. President Emmanuel Macron has called for national unity, but his address has been criticized for failing to provide specific solutions to the ongoing unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is now leading emergency meetings to address the security failures, business damages, and the underlying public grievances.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በኑሮ ውድነት እና በህዝባዊ አገልግሎት መጓደል ምክንያት በተካሄዱ ሰላማዊ ሰልፎች ወደ አመጽ እና ዝርፊያ በተቀየሩ ሁነቶች ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ገብታለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ብሄራዊ አንድነትን ቢጠሩም፣ ንግግራቸው ለችግሩ ተጨባጭ መፍትሄ ባለመኖሩ ትችት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሴባስቲያን ሌኮርኑ የጸጥታ መደፍረሱን፣ በንግድ ድርጅቶች ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት እና የህዝቡን ቅሬታ ለመፍታት አስቸኳይ ስብሰባዎችን እያካሄዱ ነው።
oromo: Faransaayiin gatii jireenyaa fi tajaajila uummataa hir’achuu mormuuf godhame, boodarra garuu gara saaminsa fi jeequmsaatti jijjiirame kana hordofee rakkoo guddaa keessa seenteetti. Preezidaant Imaanu’el Maakroon uummata tasgabbeessuuf yaalii godhanis, dubbiin isaanii furmaata qabatamaa dhabuun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Ministirri Muummee Sebaastiyaan Leekornuu jeequmsa kana, miidhaa qabeenyaa irra ga’ee fi gaaffiiwwan uummataa furuuf marii hatattamaa taa’aa jiru.

title: US President Donald Trump endorses Netanyahu for Israeli election
english: US President Donald Trump has officially declared his support for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding the country's upcoming general election. This move highlights the strong political ties between the two leaders ahead of the vote. The announcement was reported by journalists covering the administration in Washington DC.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በእስራኤል በሚካሄደው መጪ ምርጫ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እንዲመረጡ ድጋፋቸውን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል ያለውን የቅርብ የፖለቲካ ግንኙነት የሚያሳይ ነው። ዜናው በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኙ ጋዜጠኞች በዘገቡት መረጃ መሰረት የተሰማ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Yuu Es Donald Tiraamp filannoo biyyattii itti aanuuf sagalee isaanii muummicha ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuuf kennuu isaanii ifa godhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo cimaa hoggantoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan agarsiisuudha. Gabaasni kun gabaastota Waashingitan Diisii keessa jiraniin ifa ta'eera.

title: Pope greeted by crowds in first major appearance since lung cancer surgery
english: Pope Leo XIV made his first public appearance at St. Peter’s Square since undergoing surgery for lung cancer. He expressed gratitude for the prayers and support of the faithful while confirming he will slowly resume his responsibilities. Although the Vatican is monitoring his health, his medical team suggests that his upcoming trip to South America may still proceed as planned.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ ለሳንባ ካንሰር ቀዶ ጥገና ከተደረገላቸው በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ አደባባይ ለምዕመናን ታይተዋል። እርሳቸውም ለተደረገላቸው ጸሎትና ድጋፍ ምስጋናቸውን በመግለጽ፣ ቀስ በቀስ ወደ ሥራቸው እንደሚመለሱ አስታውቀዋል። የቫቲካን ባለሥልጣናት የጤንነታቸውን ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ቢሆንም፣ የህክምና ቡድናቸው በቅርቡ ወደ ደቡብ አሜሪካ ለማድረግ ያቀዱት ጉዞ ሊቀጥል እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Paaphaasii Liyo XIV baqaqsanii baasuu kennaa sombaa booda yeroo jalqabaaf ganda Qulqulluu Pheexiroositti mul'ataniiru. Hordoftoota isaaniif kadhannaa fi deeggarsa godhaniif galata galchuun, hojii isaanii suuta suutaan akka jalqaban ibsaniiru. Waajjirri Paaphaasii fayyaa isaanii hordofaa jiruus, gareen ogeeyyii fayyaa isaanii imalli gara Ameerikaa Kibbaatti karoorfame akka itti fufuuf carraan akka jiru himaniiru.

title: Lula and Bolsonaro spar in Brazil’s fiery first presidential run-off debate
english: President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro engaged in a highly aggressive first presidential run-off debate characterized by personal insults and corruption allegations. Both candidates traded accusations of dishonesty and misconduct, while clashing over critical national issues such as crime, public spending, and healthcare. With the election just a week away, the tense event highlighted the deep political division currently facing Brazil.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫው ሁለተኛ ዙር የመጀመሪያ ክርክር ላይ እርስ በርስ ጠንካራ የቃላት ጥቃት ተለዋውጠዋል። ሁለቱም እጩዎች የሙስና እና የውሸት ክስ በመሰንዘር፣ በሀገሪቱ የኑሮ ውድነት፣ በወንጀል እና በጤና አጠባበቅ ጉዳዮች ላይ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተከራክረዋል። ምርጫው ሊካሄድ አንድ ሳምንት ብቻ ሲቀረው፣ ይህ ክርክር በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ መከፋፈል አሳይቷል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin biyyattii Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi senatarri Flavio Bolsonaro falmii duraa kan yeroo lammaffaa filannoo pirezidaantumii irratti wal arrabsanii fi wal himatan raawwatan. Kaadhimamtoonni lamaanuu walitti himata malaammaltummaa fi soba dhiheessuun, akkasumas dhimmoota jireenyaa, yakkaa fi fayyaa irratti wal mormaniiru. Filannichi torban tokko qofa erga hafee booda, falmiin kun gargar bahiinsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti mul'atu ifa godheera.

title: ‘It broke my heart’: Limoges residents reel after town hall fire
english: Residents of Limoges, France, are deeply distressed after their historic 140-year-old town hall was severely damaged during recent protests. The blaze resulted in the destruction of the building's roof and iconic clock tower. Local officials have strongly denounced the incident, leaving the community shocked by the loss of their landmark.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ከተማ የሆነችው ሊሞዥ ነዋሪዎች የ140 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለው የታሪክ ቅርሳቸው የሆነው የከተማው አስተዳደር ህንፃ በቅርቡ በተቀሰቀሰው ተቃውሞ መቃጠሉ ከፍተኛ ሀዘን ውስጥ ጥሏቸዋል። የእሳቱ አደጋ የህንፃውን ጣራ እና ሰዓት ማማ ሙሉ በሙሉ አውድሟል። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ድርጊት አውግዘውት ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹም በታሪካዊ ህንፃቸው መውደም ከፍተኛ መደንገጥ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni jiraattoota magaalaa Limoges kan Faransaayi, mana bulchiinsa magaalattii kan waggaa 140 lakkoofsise ibiddan gubachuu isaatti baay'ee gaddanii jiru. Iddoon kun sababa gubachuu isaa irraa kan ka'e, gamoo sanaa fi koobbiin sa'aatii isaa guutummaatti barbadaa'eera. Aangeyyoonni magaalattii gocha kana balaaleffataniiru, uummatnis miidhaa gamoo kana irra ga'een rifataa jira.

title: AI giant Anthropic commits 5% of shares to ‘public benefit’ fund
english: The artificial intelligence company Anthropic has announced the creation of a public benefit fund, initially contributing 5% of its shares to support societal well-being. This fund aims to address challenges like labor market displacement caused by new technology through charitable donations and direct aid. As the company’s market value increases, it plans to further contribute additional equity, ensuring that financial success aligns with broader public interests.
amharic: የአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኩባንያ የሆነው አንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) ለህዝብ ጥቅም የሚውል አዲስ ፈንድ ማቋቋሙን አስታውቋል፤ ለዚህም የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ድጋፍ የኩባንያውን 5 በመቶ አክሲዮኖች መድቧል። ይህ ፈንድ በቴክኖሎጂ እድገት ምክንያት በስራ ገበያ ላይ የሚፈጠሩ ችግሮችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ማህበራዊ ጉዳዮችን ለመፍታት በገንዘብ ድጋፍ እና በሌሎች እርዳታዎች ይውላል። የኩባንያው የገበያ ዋጋ እየጨመረ በሄደ ቁጥር ለዚህ ፈንድ የሚደረገው መዋጮም አብሮ እንደሚያድግ ኩባንያው ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teknoolojii ogeessa (AI) Anthropic jedhamu, bu'aa uummataaf kan oolu qabeenya ykn 'fund' haaraa akka hundeesse beeksisera. Dhaabbatichi qooda qabeenya isaa keessaa dhibbeentaa shan (5%) jalqaba irratti qooduun, jijjiirama tekonolojiin hojii irratti fidu furuufifi gargaarsa garaagaraa godhuuf itti fayyadama. Inni kunis akkaataa guddina dhaabbatichaa wajjin walqabatee qoodni isaa fuulduratti akka dabaluuf murtaa'eera.

title: 'Very upsetting': Residents in shock after historic French town hall set alight
english: A historic town hall in Limoges, France, was severely damaged by an apparent arson attack following nationwide protests. The blaze destroyed parts of the 19th-century building, including the clock tower spire, leaving local residents shocked and saddened. Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the flames, and officials are now evaluating the building's structural safety.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ሊሞዥ ከተማ የሚገኝ ታሪካዊ የማዘጋጃ ቤት ሕንፃ በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በተካሄደ ተቃውሞ ወቅት በተፈጸመ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የ19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ሕንፃ አካል የነበረው ሰዓት ማማ በቃጠሎው የፈራረሰ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች በእጅጉ አስደንግጧል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ሲታገሉ ያደሩ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት የሕንፃውን ደህንነትና ጥንካሬ በመገምገም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Faransaay Limoozh keessatti kan argamu mana magaalaa seena qabeessa ta'e tokko, hiriira guutuu biyyattii irratti gaggeeffame hordofee ibiddaan manca'eera. Ijaarsi jaarraa 19ffaa kun miidhaa guddaa kan irra ga'e yoo ta'u, masjiin sa'aatii isaa caccabuun jiraattota naannichaa gaddisiiseera. Hojjettoonni dhaamsitoota ibiddaa halkan guutuu ibidicha dhaamsuuf carraaqqii cimaa kan taasisan yoo ta'u, amma qondaaltonni ijaarsi sun ammas amanamummaa isaa eeggatee jiraachuu isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Major fire at Canada military base leaves four dead, dozens injured
english: A devastating fire at the Wainwright military base in Alberta, Canada, has resulted in the deaths of four soldiers and left dozens injured. The blaze, which occurred during intensive live-fire combat training, was rapidly accelerated by strong winds moving across the training grounds. While the incident remains under investigation, officials have confirmed it was an accident and not related to terrorism.
amharic: በካናዳ አልቤርታ ግዛት በሚገኘው የዌይንራይት ወታደራዊ ካምፕ በተነሳ ከባድ የእሳት አደጋ የአራት ወታደሮች ህይወት ሲያልፍ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። እሳቱ የጦር ልምምድ በሚደረግበት ወቅት የነበረው ከፍተኛ ነፋስ እሳቱን በፍጥነት እንዲዛመት በማድረጉ ነው የተከሰተው። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ጉዳዩ በአደጋ የተፈጠረ እንጂ ከሽብርተኝነት ጋር ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Godina Albartaa kan Kanadaatti bakka leenjii waraanaa Wainwright irratti ibiddi guddaan ka'een loltoonni afur yoo du'an, hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Ibiddi kun kan ka'e yeroo leenjii waraanaa adeemsifamaa jiruutti bubbee cimaa tureen walqabatee saffisaan babal'achuu isaatiin tahuun ibsameera. Qorannoon kan gaggeeffamaa jiru ta'us, rakkoon kun balaa tasaa malee waltajjiin kun hidhata shororkeessummaa waliin akka hin qabne mootummaan mirkaneesseera.

title: Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia
english: Two Russian citizens have revealed their involvement in secret sabotage missions on behalf of Ukrainian intelligence inside Russia. One individual claims to have assisted in drone strikes on military facilities, while the other manages a network that gathers intelligence on Russian officials for potential targeting. While Ukrainian authorities have confirmed these individuals work for their intelligence agency, the specific details of these clandestine activities remain difficult to verify independently.
amharic: ሁለት የሩሲያ ዜጎች በሩሲያ ውስጥ በዩክሬን የስለላ ድርጅት ስም ሚስጥራዊ የጥፋት ተልእኮዎችን ሲፈጽሙ እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። አንደኛው ግለሰብ በወታደራዊ ተቋማት ላይ በተፈጸሙ የድሮን ጥቃቶች መሳተፉን ሲናገር፣ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ላይ የስለላ መረጃ የሚሰበስብ ቡድን እንደሚመራ ተናግሯል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ ግለሰቦች ለስለላ ድርጅታቸው እንደሚሰሩ ቢያረጋግጡም፣ የተከናወኑት ተግባራት ትክክለኛነት በገለልተኛ አካል ማረጋገጥ ግን አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: lammiileen Raashiyaa lama biyya isaanii keessatti qaama basaastuu Yuukreeniif jechuun hojiiwwan sabootaa fi basaasaa iccitiin gaggeessaa akka turan ibsaniiru. Namoota kana keessaa tokko buufataalee waraanaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffame irratti hirmaachuu isaa yoo ibsu, inni kaan immoo ajajoota Raashiyaa irratti ragaa funaanuudhaan basaastoota Yuukreeniif akka dabarsu ibseera. Mootummaan Yuukreen namoonni kunneen basaastoota isaanii ta'uu mirkaneessus, hojiiwwan isaan raawwatan jedhaman kana adda baasanii mirkaneeffachuun garuu ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Kinship and surveillance: The return of Somali piracy
english: A resurgence of piracy off the Somali coast has led to strict maritime security measures that are severely hurting local fishermen in towns like Bander Beyla. While some residents have turned to piracy due to frustration over illegal foreign trawlers depleting their waters, innocent fishermen are now facing bans and surveillance that prevent them from feeding their families. This cycle of instability is creating a difficult environment where local workers feel punished for the actions of pirate groups.
amharic: በሶማሊያ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ የተከሰተው የባህር ላይ ወንበዴነት ዳግም መነቃቃት በባንደር ቤይላ ከተማ የሚኖሩ ዓሣ አጥማጆችን ለከፍተኛ ችግር ዳርጓቸዋል። የውጭ ሀገር መርከቦች ሀብታቸውን እየዘረፉ መሆኑን በመቃወም አንዳንዶች ወደ ወንበዴነት ቢገቡም፣ ንጹሐን ዓሣ አጥማጆች ግን በአሁኑ ወቅት የፀጥታ ገደቦች ተጥሎባቸው የዕለት ጉርስ ማግኘት አዳጋች ሆኖባቸዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በወንበዴዎች ድርጊት ምክንያት በግፍ እየተቀጡ እንደሆነ እንዲሰማቸው አድርጓል።
oromo: Deebi’ee mul’achuu saaminsa galaana keessaa kan Somaaliyaa irra jiru, ganda Bander Beyla keessatti hojjettoota qurxummii qabaniif rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Gamoowwan alaa qabeenya isaanii saamuun isaa aarii uumee namoonni tokko tokko gara saaminsaatti akka seenan taasiseera; ta’us, qurxummii qabattoonni qulqulloonni amma dhorkaa fi hordoffii jabaa jala waan jiraniif maatii isaaniif soorata argachuu dadhabaniiru. Haalli kun jiraattonni naannichaa gocha garee saamtotaa kanaatiin walqabatee miidhaa irra ga’aa akka jiru isaanitti dhaga’ama.

title: Iran war live: Tehran says Netanyahu seeks more war; Yemen fighting flares
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is inciting further conflict to influence US involvement and protect his own political standing. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump has criticized Russia for failing to take meaningful action to support Iran during this ongoing crisis. Additionally, reports indicate that military tensions have escalated in Yemen alongside these broader regional developments.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ስልጣን ላይ ለመቆየት እና የህግ ተጠያቂነትን ለማምለጥ ሆን ብለው ጦርነቱን እያባባሱ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። በአንጻሩ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ሩሲያ በኢራን ላይ እየደረሰ ባለው ቀውስ በቂ እገዛ እያደረገች አይደለም ሲሉ ነቅፈዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ በየመን አካባቢ የሚስተዋለው የጦርነት እንቅስቃሴ በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, Ministirri Muummee Israa’eel Benjaamiin Neetanyaahuu aangoo isaanii eeggachuuf jecha waraana dhiibbaa jiran akka babal’isu himataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Pireezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doolaard Traamp, Raashiyaan dhimma Iraan irratti gargaarsa gahaa gochuu dhabuu ishee balaaleffataniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, naannawa Yamanitti waraanni itti fufee kan jiru ta’uun gabaasameera.

title: Flight from Israel makes emergency landing in Bulgaria after bomb threat
english: An Austrian Airlines flight traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna was forced to make an emergency landing in Sofia, Bulgaria, following a bomb threat. The plane was escorted by a fighter jet to ensure safety, and all 51 passengers and crew safely exited the aircraft. Authorities are currently searching the plane and investigating the source of the threat while making arrangements to help travelers reach their destination.
amharic: ከቴል አቪቭ ወደ ቪየና በመጓዝ ላይ የነበረ የኦስትሪያን አየር መንገድ አውሮፕላን የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያ በመድረሱ በቡልጋሪያ ዋና ከተማ ሶፊያ አስቸኳይ ማረፊያ አድርጓል። አውሮፕላኑ ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ እንዲያርፍ በጦር ጄት ታጅቦ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በውስጡ የነበሩት 51 ተሳፋሪዎችና የበረራ ሰራተኞች በሰላም ወርደዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአውሮፕላኑ ላይ ፍተሻ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ስለ ማስፈራሪያው ሁኔታ ምርመራ በመጀመር ተሳፋሪዎች ወደ መድረሻቸው የሚደርሱበትን መንገድ እያመቻቹ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Austrian Airlines magaalaa Tel Aviv irraa gara Vienna imalaa ture tokko, xalayaa sodaachisa boombii waan isa mudateef magaalaa bulgaariyaa Sofia keessatti ariitiin akka qubatu dirqameera. Xiyyaarichi naga qabatee akka qubatuuf xiyyaara waraanaan ergamee ture; namoonni 51 ta'anifi hojjettoonni xiyyaarichaa hundi miidhaan malee bahaniru. Qaamoleen nageenyaa qorannoo adeemsisaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, imaltoonni gara iddoo itti imalaa turanitti akka deeman haala mijeessaa jiru.

title: Protesters disrupt Ben-Gvir event forcing him off stage
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir was forced to leave an event at a Tel Aviv university due to intense protests. Demonstrators staged a sit-in and chanted slogans against fascism, leading to confrontations with security staff. As a result of the disruption, the minister was escorted out of the venue by security personnel.
amharic: የእስራኤል የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በቴል አቪቭ ዩኒቨርሲቲ በተካሄደ ፕሮግራም ላይ በገጠማቸው ተቃውሞ ምክንያት መድረኩን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች በአዳራሹ ውስጥ በመቀመጥ እና የፋሺዝም ተቃውሞ መፈክሮችን በማሰማት ረብሻ ፈጥረዋል። የፀጥታ አስከባሪዎች ጣልቃ በመግባት ሚኒስትሩን በአጃቢ ከቦታው አስወጥተዋቸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Nageenya Biyyooleessa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben-Gviir yunivarsiitii Tel Avivitti qophii irratti argamanitti mormii cimaa mudateen bakicha gadhiisanii ba'uuf dirqamaniiru. Mormitoonni taa'uudhaan mormii dhageessisaniifi faashizimii mormuun sagalee olkaasaniin, waardiyyoota wajjin walitti bu'iinsi uumameera. Walitti bu'iinsa kana hordofees, ministeerichi waardiyyoota waliin eegumsaan bakichaa ba'aniiru.

title: Netanyahu tells Americans: Iran's access to nuclear arms worse than rising gas prices
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently urged American citizens to prioritize the threat of Iran obtaining nuclear weapons over current gasoline costs. He claimed that a nuclear-armed Iran poses a far greater danger to global stability than economic fluctuations. Additionally, he suggested that fuel prices would stabilize only if the current Iranian government is removed, a task he believes can be accomplished under Donald Trump’s leadership.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ አሜሪካውያን ከነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ይልቅ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል። ኢራን የኒውክሌር ኃይል ካገኘች በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከባድ ስጋት እንደሚፈጠር የገለጹት ኔታንያሁ፣ የአሁኑ የኢራን መንግስት ሲወገድ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንደሚቀንስ ተናግረዋል። ይህንን ግብ ለማሳካት የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አመራር ወሳኝ መሆኑን በቪዲዮ መልእክታቸው አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuu, lammiileen Ameerikaa gatii boba'aa dabala deemu caalaa, Itoophiyaan (Iran) meeshaa niwukilaraa argachuu ishee akka sodaatan dhaamaniiru. Iran meeshaa niwukilaraa yoo argatte rakkoo cimaa akka uumtu ibsuun, mootummaan Iran yoo jijjiirame gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atu dubbataniiru. Sagantaa kanaan milkaa'uufis hoggansi Doonaald Traamp murteessaa akka ta'e ergaa viidiyootti fayyadamuun ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi agency warns against spreading information on attacks
english: The Saudi National Centre for Security Operations has issued a formal warning against recording or sharing images and information regarding missile or drone attacks within the country. Authorities emphasized that publicizing such content or its aftermath is strictly prohibited and carries significant legal consequences. The public is urged to refrain from circulating these materials to avoid prosecution.
amharic: የሳውዲ ብሔራዊ የደህንነት ኦፕሬሽን ማዕከል በሀገሪቱ ላይ በሚሰነዘሩ የሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃቶች ላይ ማንኛውንም መረጃ ወይም ምስል በኢንተርኔት መለቀቅ የተከለከለ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቋል። እንዲህ ዓይነቱን ይዘት መቅረጽ ወይም ማጋራት በህግ የሚያስቀጣ ተግባር እንደሆነም ማዕከሉ አስታውቋል። ህብረተሰቡ ከህግ ተጠያቂነት ለመዳን እንዲህ ያሉ መረጃዎችን ከማሰራጨት እንዲቆጠብ ተመክሯል።
oromo: Buufanni Qajeelcha Nageenyaa Biyyooleessaa Sa'udii, haleellaa xiyyaaraa ykn rookeettii biyyattii irratti raawwatamu ilaalchisee odeeffannoo ykn suuraa kamiyyuu miidiyaa irratti gadi dhiisuun akka dhorkame akeekkachiiseera. Qabiyyee akkasii waraabuu ykn raabsuun seeraan nama gaafachiisuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Haati warraa seera duraatti dhiyaachuu irraa of qusachuuf odeeffannoo akkasii qooduu irraa akka of qusatan hubachiiseera.

title: Watch: Palestinians hold mass funeral for killed loved ones in Gaza
english: In Gaza City, residents held a mass funeral for 75 victims recently pulled from building debris. Recovery teams are still searching for thousands of bodies trapped under destroyed infrastructure throughout the region. These efforts are significantly delayed because rescuers lack the necessary heavy machinery and supplies.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች ከህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ለተገኙ 75 የሟች ወገኖቻቸው የጋራ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት አካሂደዋል። በጠቅላላው የጋዛ ሰርጥ በፈራረሱ ሕንጻዎች ስር አሁንም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ አስከሬኖች ስላሉ ፍለጋው ቀጥሏል። ሆኖም የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ተገቢው ከባድ ማሽነሪ እና መሣሪያ ስለሌላቸው ስራቸውን ለመከወን ትልቅ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti namoonni 75 mana diigame jala baafaman sirni awwaalcha isaanii gamtaan raawwatameera. Bakkeewwan adda addaa keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman mana diigame jala jiraachuu waan himameef, hojiin qaama baasuu itti fufee jira. Haa ta'u malee, gareen fayyisaa kun meeshaalee gurguddaa fi deeggarsa barbaachisu waan hin qabneef hojiin kun baay'ee ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Bomb threat forces airliner from Tel Aviv to divert to Bulgaria
english: An Austrian Airlines flight traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna was forced to make an emergency landing in Sofia, Bulgaria, following a bomb threat. Bulgarian authorities dispatched a fighter jet to escort the plane, which landed safely with 57 people on board. All passengers and crew were evacuated, and security teams conducted a thorough inspection of the aircraft.
amharic: ከቴል አቪቭ ወደ ቪየና በመጓዝ ላይ የነበረ የኦስትሪያ አየር መንገድ አውሮፕላን የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያ ደርሶበት በቡልጋሪያ ዋና ከተማ ሶፊያ አስቸኳይ ማረፊያ አድርጓል። የቡልጋሪያ አየር ኃይል አውሮፕላኑን እንዲያጅብ የጦር ጄት የላከ ሲሆን፣ 57 ሰዎች የነበሩበት አውሮፕላኑ በሰላም አርፏል። ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎችና የበረራ ሰራተኞች ደህንነታቸው በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ ከተለቀቁ በኋላ የጸጥታ አካላት በአውሮፕላኑ ላይ ፍተሻ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Austriya Airlines kan gara Viyeenaa Tel Aviv irraa imalaa ture, ergaa sodaachisaa boombii erga qaqqabee booda gara Bulgaariyaatti akka gadi bu'u dirqameera. Mootummaan Bulgaariyaa xiyyaaricha eegsisuuf xiyyaara waraanaa ergeera; namoota 57 of keessaa qabuunis nagaan lafa ga'eera. Imaltoonni fi hojjettoonni hundi xiyyaaricha keessaa erga ba'anii booda, qaamni nageenyaa xiyyaaricha sakatta'uu jalqabeera.

title: Araghchi says Netanyahu is pushing for renewed war on Iran
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is attempting to provoke a war with Iran to avoid his own legal troubles. Araghchi warned that dragging the United States into such a conflict would have dangerous consequences for all parties involved. He also emphasized that Iran is prepared for potential escalation, noting that past attempts to undermine the country only made it stronger.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ፣ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የራሳቸውን የህግ ችግር ለመሸሽ ከኢራን ጋር ጦርነት እንዲቀሰቀስ እየገፋፉ ነው ብለዋል። አራግቺ አሜሪካን ወደዚህ ግጭት መጎተት ለሁሉም ወገኖች አደገኛ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን ለማንኛውም አይነት ሁኔታ ዝግጁ እንደሆነች እና ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ የጥቃት ሙከራዎች ሀገሪቱን ይበልጥ ጠንካራ ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu rakkoo seeraa isaanii irraa miliquuf jecha waraana Iraan waliin akka ka'u dirqisiisaa jiru jechuun himatan. Araagchi, Ameerikaan waraana kana keessatti akka hirmaattu gochuun hundaafuu miidhaa guddaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan haala kamuuf qophiidha kan jedhan yoo ta'u, kanaan dura yaalii isaan irratti taasifame hundaan biyyattiin caalaatti jabachuu ishee ibsaniiru.

title: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
english: President Donald Trump has delayed new sanctions on Russia, explaining that the move is intended to maintain momentum in ongoing peace talks. This decision comes amid growing diplomatic friction between Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who remains critical of Russia's actions. While Moscow welcomed the decision, the relationship between Washington and Kyiv has become increasingly strained.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ ላይ ሊጣል የነበረውን ማዕቀብ ያዘገዩት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለውን የሰላም ድርድር ለማስቀጠል እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በትራምፕ እና በዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ መካከል እየተፈጠረ ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ አለመግባባት ይበልጥ ጎላ አድርጎ አሳይቷል። ሞስኮ ይህንን እርምጃ በደስታ ስትቀበለው፣ በዋሽንግተን እና በኪየቭ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት ግን ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየሻከረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolnaald Traamp adabbii Ruusiyaa irratti kaa'uuf karoorfame ture kan isaan itti fufsiisan, mariin nagaa akka hin dhaabanneef akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Murteen kun gidduu isaanii fi pirezidaantii Yuukreen Vooloodiimir Zeeleniskii gidduutti rakkoon diippiloomaasii akka dabalu godheera. Mootummaan Ruusiyaa murtee kana kan simate yoo ta'u, hariiroon Waashingtanii fi Kiyiv gidduu jiru garuu caalaatti hammaachaa jira.

title: Venezuela opposition renews support for Maria Corina Machado as leader
english: A coalition of Venezuelan opposition parties has officially reaffirmed its support for exiled leader Maria Corina Machado. The group is demanding a democratic transition that includes the release of political prisoners, the return of those in exile, and the holding of free, fair elections. This move aims to increase pressure on the current leadership, which has faced international criticism over human rights issues.
