oromo: Waldaan mormitoota biyya Venezueelaa hogganaa isaan biyya alaa jiru Maariyaa Koriinaa Maachaadoo irratti deeggarsa qaban guyyaa har'aa mirkaneessaniiru. Gareen kun hidhamtoonni siyaasaa akka hiikaman, namoonni baqatan akka deebi'an, akkasumas filannoon bilisaa fi haqa qabeessi akka geggeeffamu gaafataa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaa ammaa kan mirga namoomaa darbuun himatamu irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Alberta independence referendum: Will separatists survive a loss?
english: Alberta is holding its first-ever referendum on independence, though polls suggest voters will likely choose to remain part of Canada. Despite the expected defeat, separatist leaders are committed to continuing their movement to gain more political influence. Even a victory for the separation option would only be a preliminary step, as leaving Canada would require complex legal negotiations with federal and Indigenous authorities.
amharic: የአልበርታ ግዛት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከካናዳ የመገንጠል ጉዳይ ላይ ህዝበ ውሳኔ እያካሄደች ሲሆን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ መራጮች በካናዳ ህብረት ውስጥ ለመቆየት እንደሚመርጡ ይጠበቃል። የመገንጠል ደጋፊዎች ሽንፈት ቢገጥማቸውም እንቅስቃሴያቸውን ለመቀጠል እና ተፅእኖ ለመፍጠር ቁርጠኛ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። የመገንጠል ሃሳብ ቢጸድቅ እንኳን፣ የካናዳ አካል መሆንን ለመተው ከፌዴራል መንግስት እና ከሀገር በቀል ተወላጆች ጋር ረጅም እና ውስብስብ የህግ ድርድር ማድረግ ግድ ይላል።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo Alberta guyyaa har'aa yeroo jalqabaatiif dhimma bilisummaa isaanii irratti yaada ummataa gaafachaa jira, garuu qorannoon akka mul'isutti namoonni hedduun biyya Kanadaa keessa turuu akka filatan ni tilmaamama. Hogganoonni garee adda ba'uu fedhan injifatamuun isaanii akka hin oolle beekus, sochiin isaanii gara fuulduraatti itti fufuuf waadaa galaniiru. Yaanni adda ba'uu kun yoo darbe iyyuu, Kanadaa keessaa ba'uun adeemsa seeraa kan gaafatuufi mootummaa federaalaa fi uummata biyya sanaa waliin marii walxaxaa kan barbaadu dha.

title: Macron condemns violence after riots lead to looting and mass arrests
english: French President Emmanuel Macron has spoken out against the recent violent riots that resulted in widespread looting and numerous arrests. The unrest was fueled by public frustration regarding the high cost of living and inadequate educational facilities. President Macron emphasized that those who targeted government property will be held legally accountable for their actions.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት አማኑኤል ማክሮን በሀገሪቱ ተከስቶ በነበረው የሁከትና የዝርፊያ ድርጊት ላይ ጠንካራ ውግዘታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ተቃውሞው የተነሳው የኑሮ ውድነትን እና የትምህርት ቤት ሁኔታዎችን በመቃወም ሲሆን በሰፊው የህግ እርምጃዎች እንዲወሰዱ አድርጓል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የመንግስት ተቋማትን ያወደሙ አካላት ለፈጸሙት ጥፋት በህግ እንደሚጠየቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon jeequmsa fi saamicha dhiheenya kana biyyattii keessatti mudate balaaleeffataniiru. Mormiin kun gatii jireenyaa fi haala manneen barnootaa gaariin hin taaneen kan ka'e yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduunis hidhamaniiru. Pireezidaantiin kun akka jedhanitti, namoonni qabeenya mootummaa irratti miidhaa geessisan seeratti kan dhiyaatan ta'a.

title: Macron calls for 'calm and order' after riots across France
english: French President Emmanuel Macron has appealed for peace following widespread rioting and looting triggered by protests over the cost of living and rising fuel prices. While acknowledging the frustration of the protesters, Macron condemned the destruction of public property and confirmed that thousands of individuals have been arrested. Authorities are now dealing with significant damage to buildings and ongoing clashes between police and violent groups in several cities.
amharic: የፈረንሳዩ ፕሬዚዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪንና የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ ምክንያት ሰላምና ስርዓትን እንዲጠበቅ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ የተቃዋሚዎችን ስሜት ቢረዱም፣ በንብረት ላይ የሚደርሰውን ውድመት ግን አውግዘዋል፤ በሁከቱም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር መዋላቸው ተገልጿል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የፈረንሳይ ከተሞች በሰፊው የደረሰውን የንብረት ውድመት እየገመገሙ ሲሆን፣ በፖሊስና በአመጸኞች መካከል ያለው ግጭትም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin Faransaay Imaanuweel Maakroon, gatii boba’aa fi baasii jireenyaa dabuu mormuun hiriirri gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuu hordofee tasgabbii akka bu’u gaafataniiru. Maakroon gadda uummata qabu akka hubatan ibsanii, garuu mancaatii qabeenyaa fi saamicha raawwatame balaaleffataniiru; jeequmsa kanaan walqabatee namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman to’annoo jala oolchaniiru. Magaalota garaagaraatti dhaabbilee fi manneen irratti mancaatii cimaan kan ga’e yoo ta’u, walitti bu’iinsi poolisii fi namoota jeequmsa uuman gidduutti geggeeffamaa jiru itti fufeera.

title: What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base
english: A massive fire at the Wainwright military base in Alberta has resulted in the deaths of four service members and left dozens of others seriously injured. While authorities are still investigating the cause, early reports suggest it may have been triggered by a gas line incident during a training exercise, exacerbated by strong winds. Prime Minister Mark Carney has labeled the tragedy one of the most severe in the nation's military history, noting that emergency crews worked through difficult conditions to contain the blaze.
amharic: በአልበርታ ግዛት በሚገኘው የዌይንራይት ወታደራዊ ካምፕ በተነሳ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ የአራት ወታደሮች ህይወት ሲያልፍ፣ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የእሳቱ መንስኤ በምርመራ ላይ ቢሆንም፣ በስልጠና ወቅት የተከሰተ የጋዝ ፍንዳታ እና ጠንካራ የነፋስ አቅጣጫ ለእሳቱ መባባስ ምክንያት እንደሆኑ ተጠቁሟል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ይህ አደጋ በሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ታሪክ እጅግ አሳዛኝ ከሆኑት መካከል አንዱ መሆኑን ገልጸው፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Buufata waraanaa Wainwright kan Alberta keessatti mudate ibidda guddaan lubbuu loltoota afur galaafateera, akkasumas namoota hedduu irratti miidhaa cimaa geessiseera. Sababiin ibidda kanaa ammallee qoratamaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, gabaasoonni jalqabaa akka agarsiisanitti, leenjii waraanaa irratti mi'a gaazii tuquun fi qilleensa cimaa turetu ibidda kana saffisiise jedhamee shakkama. Muummichi ministeeraa Maark Kaarnii balaa kana seenaa waraana biyyattii keessatti balaa gurguddaa keessaa tokko jechuun ibsanii, gareen fannisuu balaa haala ulfaataa keessa taa'anii ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaquu isaanii dubbataniiru.

title: Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US
english: A surge in powerful synthetic drugs is threatening communities across the United States, sparking new concerns about the ongoing addiction crisis. While overdose deaths have recently declined, officials remain worried about the prevalence of dangerous substances like the animal tranquilizer known as 'tranq.' Local neighborhoods in Chicago are currently working hard on the front lines to combat the impact of these increasingly lethal narcotics.

oromo: Qorichoonni sammuu namaa hadoochan kanneen suuta jedhanii biyyattii keessatti babal’achaa jiran rakkoo fayyaa fi hawaasummaa cimaa uumaa jiru. Magaala Chicago keessatti, hawaasni rakkoo kana dhaabsisuufi miidhaa inni geessisu hir’isuuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jira.

title: Fire engulfs Albania’s Supreme Court as protests enter fifth day
english: A fire broke out at the Supreme Court building in Tirana as ongoing anti-government demonstrations reached their fifth day. Protesters are taking to the streets to express their frustration with issues including corruption, unemployment, and the current state of education. Authorities are managing the situation as civil unrest continues to grip the capital.

Rakkoolee kanneen irraa kan ka'e mormiin kun hammaatee kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, mootummaan tasgabbiif tattaaffii gochaa jira.

title: ‘Anger and shame’: Macron denounces France’s nationwide rioting, looting
english: French President Emmanuel Macron has condemned the widespread riots and looting across the nation, labeling the violent actions as an attempt to undermine the republic. Following a weekend of intense unrest that led to thousands of arrests and many injuries to law enforcement, he pledged to hold perpetrators accountable while promising government support for those impacted. Although Macron called for national unity and calm, his remarks were met with skepticism by political opponents who blame his administration for failing to maintain order.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon, jeequmsaa fi saamicha biyyattii keessatti babal'ate balaaleffachuun, gochi kun sirna biyyattii diiguuf yaali godhameedha jedhan. Sochii guyyoota darban keessa mudateen namootni kumaan lakkaa'aman hidhamanii, poolisootni hedduunis miidhamuu isaanii hordofee, yakka raawwataniif akka itti gaafatamanif mootummaan gargaarsa akka godhu waadaa galan. Maakroon tokkummaa fi nagaa akka buufatan gaafataniyyuu, mormitootni isaanii mootummaan nagaa eeguu dadhabeera jechuun isaan qeeqaniiru.

title: What’s behind Europe’s youth protests?
english: Young people across Europe are currently involved in widespread protests, leading to concerns about public order. While some online discussions attempt to blame these disturbances on immigration, the actual underlying causes of the unrest remain more complex. This report examines the specific factors motivating these young demonstrators to take to the streets.
amharic: በአውሮፓ ወጣቶች የሚመሩ ተቃውሞዎች እየተስፋፉ መጥተዋል፣ ይህም በሕዝብ ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። አንዳንዶች ይህንን ሁከት ከስደት ጋር ለማያያዝ ቢሞክሩም፣ የችግሩ መነሻ ግን ከዚህ የበለጠ ሰፊ እና የተወሳሰበ ነው። ይህ ዘገባ ወጣቶቹ ለተቃውሞ እንዲነሳሱ ያደረጉትን ዋና ዋና ምክንያቶች ይዳስሳል።
oromo: Itti fufinsaan hiriirri dargaggootaan durfamu biyyoota Awurooppaa keessatti babal'achaa jiraachuu isaa hordofee yaaddoon nageenyaa uumameera. Haala kanaan walqabatee namoonni tokko tokko hookkicha godaantota irratti xiyyeeffachuun ibsuuf yaalanis, sababni dhugaan hookkichaas kun caalaatti kan walxaxeedha. Gabaasni kun wantoota dargaggoonni kun hiriira kana akka ba'an kakaasan qorata.

title: India’s crackdown on cockroaches, critics and cameras
english: In India, youth-led protests have erupted in Delhi following reports that millions of voters were removed from election rolls. The government has responded by suppressing the media, leading to the harassment and detention of numerous journalists. Despite these efforts to silence dissent, a new generation of activists continues to openly challenge the state's actions.
amharic: በህንድ ዋና ከተማ ዴሊ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ መራጮች ከምርጫ ዝርዝር ውስጥ መሰረዛቸውን ተከትሎ በወጣቶች የሚመራ ተቃውሞ ተቀስቅሷል። መንግስት ይህንን ተቃውሞ ለመግታት በጋዜጠኞች ላይ እስር እና እንግልት በመፈጸም የሚዲያ ነፃነትን እያፈነ ይገኛል። ይህ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ ትውልድ የመንግስትን አካሄድ በድፍረት መቃወሙን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman galmee filannoo keessaa haqamuu isaanii hordofee, dargaggoonni magaalaa Deelii keessatti mormii guddaa kaasaniiru. Mootummaan mormii kana dhaabuuf jecha miidiyaalee irratti dhiibbaa gochuun, gaazexeessitoota hidhaa fi miidhaaf saaxilaa jira. Haata'u malee, dhiibbaa kana hunda dandamatanii, dhaloonni haaraan gocha mootummaa kana mormuu itti fufeera.

title: How will Europe deal with youth-led protests?
english: Across Europe, youth-led protests are intensifying as students demand reforms to education, relief from rising living costs, and an end to social service cuts. These demonstrations reflect growing public dissatisfaction with government leadership and are spreading beyond France to other parts of the continent. Meanwhile, right-wing political factions are attempting to leverage the current unrest to gain support and influence.
amharic: በአውሮፓ በተለያዩ ሀገራት ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ስርዓት ማሻሻያ፣ የኑሮ ውድነት መፍትሄ እና የማህበራዊ አገልግሎቶች ቁረጣ እንዲቆም በመጠየቅ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎችን እያካሄዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች በመንግስት አመራሮች ላይ ያላቸውን ቅር መሰኘት የሚገልጹ ሲሆን፣ ከፈረንሳይ አልፎ ወደ ሌሎች የአህጉሪቱ ክፍሎች ተስፋፍተዋል። በዚህ ወቅት የቀኝ ዘመም የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች ይህን አለመረጋጋት በመጠቀም ተጽዕኖ ለመፍጠር እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Awurooppaa keessatti barattoonni fooyya'iinsa barnootaa, gatii jireenyaa olka'eef furmaata, akkasumas kutaannaan tajaajila hawaasummaa akka dhaabbatu gaafachuun hiriira mormii geggeessaa jiru. Hiriironni kun hoggantoota mootummaatti gammadduu ta'uu dhabuu ummataa kan agarsiisan yoo ta'u, biyya Faransaayiin darbee gara biyyoota Awurooppaa birootti babal'achaa jira. Gama biraatiin, gareewwan siyaasaa mirga-qaxxaamuraa ta'an yeroo kanatti fayyadamuun dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: Why the US is holding secret talks with Myanmar’s military ruler
english: The U.S. government is engaged in private discussions with Myanmar's military leadership despite international accusations of genocide against the regime. These diplomatic efforts appear to be driven by American interests in securing rare earth minerals and resolving the detention of a U.S. businessman. Additionally, reports suggest that a lobbyist associated with Donald Trump is profiting from a deal linked to the junta.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በምያንማር ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ክስ ቢኖርም፣ ከእነሱ ጋር በድብቅ ንግግሮችን እያደረገ ይገኛል። እነዚህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች የአሜሪካን ብርቅዬ ማዕድናት ፍላጎት ለማሟላት እና በአገሪቱ የታሰረን የአሜሪካ ነጋዴ ለመፍታት ያለሙ ይመስላሉ። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ፣ ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ግንኙነት ያለው አንድ ሎቢስት ከወታደራዊው መንግስት ጋር በተያያዘ ስምምነት ተጠቃሚ መሆኑ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota waraana Myanmar irratti himata dhumaatii sanyii dhiyaateera ta’us, isaan waliin marii dhokataa gaggeessaa jira. Hariiroon kun kanneen jalqabameefis fedhii Ameerikaan qabeenya lafa keessaa (rare earth minerals) irratti qabduu fi daldalaan Ameerikaa tokko hidhaa irraa baasuufi. Kana malees, gorsaan siyaasaa Donald Trump waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu tokko bulchiinsa waraana sanaa waliin walitti dhufeenyaan qabeenya argachaa jiraachuu gabaasni ni addeessa.

title: Indian Bollywood superstar Tiger Shroff allegedly shot at by gunmen
english: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff is safe after unidentified individuals fired shots at his vehicle in Mumbai. While the actor remained unhurt, his driver and a local rickshaw driver sustained injuries during the attack. Authorities are currently investigating the incident and checking the validity of a social media post that attributed the shooting to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang.
amharic: የቦሊውድ ተዋናይ ታይገር ሽሮፍ በሙምባይ በጉዞ ላይ እያሉ በማይታወቁ ሰዎች በተከፈተባቸው ተኩስ ከጉዳት ተርፈዋል። ተዋናዩ ምንም ሳይሆኑ ቢቀሩም፣ የራሳቸው ሹፌር እና የአንድ ባለ ሶስት እግር ተሽከርካሪ ሹፌር በጥይት ተመተው ተጎድተዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱ በሎረንስ ቢሽኖይ ቡድን እንደተፈጸመ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰራጨውን መግለጫ እያጣራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Aartistiin Bollywood Tiger Shroff magaalatti Mumbai keessatti namoota hin beekamneen rasaasaan irratti banamee osoo jiruu balaa irraa ooleera. Artistichi miidhaa malee kan oole yoo ta'u, ogeessi konkolaachisaa isaa fi namni konkolaataa fe'umsaa tokko miidhaan irra ga'eera. Poolisiin qindoomina garee Lawrence Bishnoi waliin walqabatee miidiyaalee hawaasummaa irratti ibsi bahe dhugummaa isaa qorachaa jira.

title: JERUSALEM DAILY: Settlers attack EU diplomats
english: A group of Israeli settlers assaulted a delegation of European Union diplomats in the occupied West Bank. The attack occurred while the diplomats were observing olive harvest activities near the town of Taybeh. Reports indicate that Israeli security forces failed to intervene or address prior warnings regarding the safety of the visiting officials.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች የአውሮፓ ህብረት ዲፕሎማቶችን ቡድን አጥቅተዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ዲፕሎማቶቹ በታይቤህ አቅራቢያ የሚካሄደውን የወይራ ምርት መሰብሰብ ስራ ሲመለከቱ ነበር። እስራኤላዊያን የጸጥታ አስከባሪዎች ስለ ልዑካኑ ደህንነት ቀድሞ የደረሳቸውን ማስጠንቀቂያ ችላ ብለዋል ተብሏል።
oromo: Gareen qubattoota Israa'el qondaaltota gamtaa Awurooppaa kan naannoo West Baanki keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun kan mudate yommuu qondaaltonni kunneen magaalattii Xayyebhitti hojii midhaan ejersaa sassaabuu ilaalaa turanitti. Meeshatootni nageenyaa Israa'el waayee nageenya garee kanaa akeekkachiisa duraan kennameef xiyyeeffannoo akka hin kennine gabaafameera.

title: Madueke scores only goal as below-par Arsenal beat Nottingham Forest
english: Arsenal secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Nottingham Forest thanks to a late goal from substitute Noni Madueke. Despite a lackluster performance where they struggled to create chances, the win keeps Arsenal within three points of league leaders Manchester City. This result marks the team's third consecutive victory as they continue to recover from earlier struggles this season.
amharic: አርሰናል በተቀያሪው ተጫዋች ኖኒ ማዱዌኬ የጨዋታው መገባደጃ ላይ ባስቆጠራት ግብ ኖቲንግሃም ፎረስትን 1 ለ 0 አሸንፏል። ቡድኑ አሳማኝ ያልሆነ እንቅስቃሴ ቢያደርግም እና የግብ እድሎችን ለመፍጠር ቢቸገርም፣ ድሉ በአንደኛ ደረጃ ላይ ካለው ማንቸስተር ሲቲ ጋር ያለውን የሶስት ነጥብ ልዩነት እንዲጠብቅ አስችሎታል። ይህ ውጤት አርሰናል በውድድር ዘመኑ መጀመሪያ ላይ ካሳየው መውረድ ተላቆ ተከታታይ ድሎችን እንዲያገኝ ረድቶታል።
oromo: Arsenal goolii Noni Madueke bakka bu'ee seenen daqiiqaa 80ffaa irratti argameen Nottingham Forest 1-0 injifateera. Gaggeessaan leenjisaa Mikel Arteta gareen isaa tapha gaarii akka hin taphanne beekamee utuu jiruu, injifannoon kun ammoo Arsenal gubbaa liigichaa irratti kan argamu Manchester City irraa qabxii sadii qofa akka gadi fagaatu isa godheera. Kunis gareen Arsenal tapha sadan darban injifachuun haala gaariin gara dursaa jiruutti deebi'aa jiraachuu isaanii agarsiisa.

title: Residents recount drone strikes in Ethiopia’s northern Tigray region
english: New military clashes have erupted in Ethiopia's Tigray region, sparking concerns about the potential for broader conflict in the area. People living in the border city of Adigrat have reported witnessing drone attacks carried out by Ethiopian forces targeting Eritrean troops. These accounts highlight the ongoing instability and violent confrontations currently affecting the region.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል በምትገኘው ትግራይ ክልል ዳግም የተከሰተው ግጭት ስጋትን እየፈጠረ ይገኛል። በአዲግራት ከተማ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች የኢትዮጵያ ኃይሎች በኤርትራ ወታደሮች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመረጋጋት እና ግጭት አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Tigraayitti lola haaraa dhalateen walqabatee soda qaqqabaa jiru bal'ateera. Jiraattonni magaaloo Adigraat akka ibsanitti, waraanni Itoophiyaa waraana Eertiraa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeessuu isaanii ragaa bahan. Gochi kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti hammaataa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Photos: Antigovernment protesters clash with police in Albania’s capital
english: Anti-government protesters in Tirana, Albania, recently clashed with riot police during the sixth day of student-led demonstrations. The participants are demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, citing concerns over government corruption, expensive tuition, and subpar university facilities. These protests are part of a broader period of civil unrest in the country that has lasted for several months.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና ተማሪዎች የሚመሩት ፀረ-መንግስት ተቃውሞዎች ለስድስተኛ ቀኑ በቀጠሉበት ወቅት ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የመንግስትን ሙስና፣ ከፍተኛ የትምህርት ክፍያ እና የዩኒቨርሲቲዎች የአገልግሎት መጓደል በመቃወም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ነው። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች ባለፉት ጥቂት ወራት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ሲካሄድ ከነበረው ተከታታይ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Albaniyaa Tiraanaatti barattootaan kan durfamu hiriirri mormii mootummaa guyyaa ja'affaa isaatiif walitti buiinsa poolisii waliin uumee jira. Hiriirtotni kunneen malaammaltummaa mootummaa, kaffaltii barnootaa olka'aa fi haala barnootaa irratti komii qabaachuun, Muummichi Ministeeraa Edi Raamaan aangoo akka gadi lakkisan gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirri kun, ji'oota darban keessa biyyattii keessatti mormii mootummaa irratti taasifamaa ture keessaa kan maddudha.

title: Manchester United held at Leeds despite improved performance for Carrick
english: Manchester United managed only a 1-1 draw against Leeds United following a difficult week for the club. Despite Bryan Mbeumo scoring the opening goal for United, Dominic Calvert-Lewin equalized for Leeds shortly after halftime. This result leaves Michael Carrick’s team struggling in 13th place as they continue to face significant pressure.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ በሊድስ ዩናይትድ ሜዳ 1 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት አቻ ተለያይቷል። ብራያን ምቤሞ ለዩናይትድ የመጀመሪያውን ግብ ቢያስቆጥርም፣ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ ዶሚኒክ ካልቨርት-ሌዊን ለሊድስ አቻ ማድረግ ችሏል። ይህ ውጤት የክለቡን አሰልጣኝ ሚካኤል ካሪክን ጫና ከማቃለል ይልቅ ቡድኑ በሊጉ ደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ 13ኛ ደረጃ ላይ እንዲቀመጥ አስገድዶታል።
oromo: Maanchistar Yuunayitadiin tapha Leeds Yuunayitadii wajjin taasisaniin 1-1 qixxee bahaniru. Bryan Mbeumo gola jalqabaa Yuunayitadiif lakkoofsisus, lammaffaa irratti Dominic Calvert-Lewin Leedsif gola qixxeessitu galcheera. Bu'aan kun maallaqa qabuun qeeqamaa kan jiru leenjisaa Michael Carrick irratti dhiibbaa itti fufsiiseera, akkasumas kilabichi sadarkaa 13ffaa irratti akka argamu godheera.

title: EU condemns Israeli settler attack on diplomats in occupied West Bank
english: The European Union has officially denounced an assault by Israeli settlers on a diplomatic convoy visiting Palestinian olive farmers in the occupied West Bank. During the incident, masked individuals threatened the delegation, which included officials from France, Belgium, and Poland, and damaged a diplomatic vehicle. The EU is now demanding that Israeli authorities hold the attackers accountable and take stronger measures to prevent future violence against civilians and international visitors.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዟል። የፈረንሳይ፣ የቤልጂየም እና የፖላንድ ዲፕሎማቶች የፍልስጤም የዘይቱን አዝመራ ለሚሰበስቡ አርሶ አደሮች ድጋፍ ለመስጠት በሄዱበት ወቅት ነበር ጭንብል የለበሱ ሰዎች ጥቃት የሰነዘሩባቸው። ህብረቱ እስራኤል ተጠያቂነትን እንዲያስከብር እና ወደፊት በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚደርሱ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa haleellaa qondaaltota dippilomaasii biyyoota Awurooppaa irratti godaantota Israa'el ganda West Bank keessatti raawwatame cimssee balaaleffateera. Dippilomaatonni Firaansi, Beeljiyamii fi Poolaandi qonnaan bulaa Filisxeemii kan ejersa haamaa jiran gargaaruuf deemanii utuu jiranii, namoonni fuula haguuggatan haleellaa isaan irratti raawwataniiru. Gamtaan Awurooppaa mootummaan Israa'el haleeltota seeraatti dhiyeessuudhaan gara fuulduraatti haleellaa akkanaa ittisuuf tarkaanfii fudhachuu qaba jechuun gaafateera.

title: Tirana sees sixth day of violent protests as Albania’s PM refuses to resign
english: Albania’s capital, Tirana, has faced six days of violent anti-government protests as citizens demand Prime Minister Edi Rama’s resignation over corruption and economic concerns. While demonstrators continue to clash with police, Rama has refused to step down, warning that the instability could jeopardize the country's goal of joining the European Union. Both the government and the protesters remain firm in their positions, leaving the future of the situation uncertain.
amharic: የአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና በሙስና እና በኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ሳቢያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ የሚጠይቁ ተቃውሞዎች ለስድስት ቀናት እየተካሄደባት ይገኛል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣን ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ያልሆኑ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች አገሪቱ ወደ አውሮፓ ህብረት ለመግባት ያላትን እቅድ ሊጎዱ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአሁኑ ሰዓት በህዝቡና በመንግስት መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት ተባብሶ በመቀጠሉ የሁኔታው መፍትሄ ምን ሊሆን እንደሚችል ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Magaalaan guddittii Albaaniyaa Tiraanaa, mormii mootummaan irratti ka'een guyyaa ja'aaf jeequmsa keessa jirti; lammiileenis dhimmoota malaammaltummaa fi dinagdee kaasuun Muummee Ministiraa Eedii Raamaa aangoorraa akka bu'an gaafachaa jiru. Muummeen Ministiraa Raamaa aangoorraa bu'uu kan didan yoo ta'u, jeequmsi kun biyyattiin gara gamtaa Awurooppaatti makamuuf qabdu irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Mootummaanis ta'e hiriirtoonni yaada isaanii irratti jabaachuu isaaniitiin, gara fuulduraatti maal akka uumamu beekuun rakkisaa ta'eera.

title: A timeline of West Bank attacks on Palestinians and foreign officials
english: Israeli settlers have recently escalated violent attacks against Palestinians and visiting foreign diplomats in the occupied West Bank. These assaults, which often coincide with the annual olive harvest, have drawn international condemnation, including from the European Union. Victims include high-ranking European officials and journalists who were targeted while supporting local farmers.
amharic: በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ ግዛት የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን እና በውጭ ሀገር ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የሚፈጽሙት ጥቃት በቅርቡ ተባብሷል። የወይራ መከር ወቅት ላይ ተገጣጥሞ የሚከሰተው ይህ ጥቃት የአውሮፓ ህብረትን ጨምሮ ዓለም አቀፍ ኩነኔን አስከትሏል። ጥቃቱ በአካባቢው አርሶ አደሮችን ለመደገፍ በመጡ ዲፕሎማቶች እና ጋዜጠኞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር።
oromo: Godina Lixaa (West Bank) qabame keessatti, jiraattonni qubattoota Israa'el loltoota fi diippiloomaatota biyya alaa irratti weerara raawwachuun isaanii dabaleera. Weerarri kun yeroo haamaa ejjersaa waliin kan wal-qabatu yoo ta'u, gamtaan Awurooppaa dabalatee qaamoleen idil-addunyaa akka balaaleffatan taasiseera. Miidhaan kun qonnaan bultoota naannichaa gargaaruuf kan dhufan diippiloomaatota Awurooppaa fi gaazexeessitota irratti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
english: Widespread riots and looting erupted across major French cities following large-scale demonstrations against rising living costs and fuel prices. While many protesters remained peaceful, violent groups damaged hundreds of shops, set vehicles on fire, and clashed with police using tear gas and water cannons. Authorities reported nearly 1,800 arrests and hundreds of injuries among security forces as the country deals with extensive property damage.
amharic: የኑሮ ውድነትን እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪን በመቃወም በፈረንሳይ ከተሞች በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ወቅት ከፍተኛ ሁከት እና ዘረፋ ተከስቷል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኞቹ ተቃዋሚዎች በሰላማዊ መንገድ ቢንቀሳቀሱም፣ አንዳንድ ጥቃቅን ቡድኖች በሱቆች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ፣ መኪኖችን በማቃጠል እና ከፖሊስ ጋር በመጋጨት ከፍተኛ ብጥብጥ ፈጥረዋል። በዚህ ሁከት ከ1,800 በላይ ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ በፀጥታ ኃይሎች ላይ ጉዳት ከመድረሱም በላይ በርካታ ንብረቶች ወድመዋል።
oromo: Faransaatti, gatii jireenyaa fi gatii boba’aa dabee irratti mormiin guddaan gaggeeffamaa ture gara jeequmsaa fi saamichaatti jijjiirameera. Mormitoonni hedduun nagaadhaan kan hiriiran ta’us, gareen tokko tokko immoo suuqota mancaasuun, konkolaattota gubuu fi poolisoota wajjin walitti bu’uun miidhaa guddaa geessisaniiru. Jeequmsa kanaan namoonni 1,800 ol kan hidhaman yoo ta’u, humnoonni nageenyaa fi qabeenyawwan hedduun miidhamaniiru.

title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
english: A deadly overnight drone attack struck two major oil facilities in St. Petersburg, causing fires and several casualties. In addition to the oil infrastructure, a data center and a logistics hub were also hit, leading to local service disruptions and structural damage to nearby homes. This operation follows Ukraine's decision to resume strikes on Russian economic targets after accusing Moscow of repeatedly attacking its energy grid.
amharic: በቅዱስ ፒተርስበርግ በተፈጸመ የሌሊት ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ዋና ዋና የነዳጅ ማከማቻዎች ተመተው የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፣ በዚህም ምክንያት የሰው ህይወት አልፏል። ከነዳጅ ማከማቻዎቹ በተጨማሪ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች እና የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከላት ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ የአካባቢው መኖሪያ ቤቶችም ተጎድተዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ሩሲያ የዩክሬንን የኃይል ማመንጫዎች ማጥቃቷን በመቃወም ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተቋማት ላይ የጀመረችውን ድብደባ እንደገና መቀጠሏን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Halkan bakka buufataalee boba'aa guddaa St. Petersburgitti argaman irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeeffameen namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni biroo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa kanaan dhaabbileen teeknoolojii fi bakkeewwan oomishaalee qindeessan kanneen akka Ozon fi VK miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, yeroo ammaa kanatti yeroo hedduu elektirikii fi buufataalee anniisaa Yukreen irratti miidhaa gahuuf deebii kennuuf Yukreen haleellaa diinagdee Raashiyaa irratti banatte keessaa tokko.

title: Is FIFA scrapping its peace prize after awarding it to US President Trump?
english: FIFA is considering abolishing its newly established Peace Prize after facing backlash for awarding it to US President Donald Trump. Several council members have requested the cancellation of the honor, arguing it lacks merit and deviates from the organization's focus on sports. If discontinued, Donald Trump would remain the first and only recipient of the controversial award.
amharic: ፊፋ ለዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰጠውን የሰላም ሽልማት ውዝግብ ካስነሳ በኋላ ለመሰረዝ እያሰበ ነው። የፊፋ ምክር ቤት አባላት ሽልማቱ ትርጉም የለሽ እና ከስፖርታዊ ዓላማው ውጪ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ እንዲሰረዝ ጠይቀዋል። ውሳኔው ተግባራዊ ከሆነ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዚህ አወዛጋቢ ሽልማት የመጀመሪያ እና ብቸኛው ተሸላሚ ሆነው ይቆያሉ።
oromo: FIFA badhaasa nageenyaa haaraa hundeesse erga Prezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonald Traampitti kennee booda, mormii guddaa mudatee waan jiruuf badhaasicha haquuf karoorfachaa jira. Miseensonni koree FIFA tokko tokko badhaasichi bu'aa hin qabu fi federeeshinichaa gara ispoortiitti xiyyeeffatu irraa kan faallaa dha jechuun akka dhaabbatu gaafataniiru. Yaadni kun yoo ragga'e, Doonald Traamp badhaasa mormii guddaa kaase kana kan argate namicha jalqabaa fi dhumaa ta'anii tura.

title: Paris residents tell Al Jazeera they’re dismayed by protest damage
english: Residents of Paris have expressed significant frustration following violent protests that resulted in widespread destruction throughout the city. During these disturbances, authorities detained over 1,000 individuals due to reports of looting and rioting. Local citizens are troubled by the extensive damage left behind in the wake of these chaotic events.
amharic: በፓሪስ ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ ምክንያት በደረሰው ውድመት የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በወቅቱ በተፈጠረው ግጭት እና ዝርፊያ ሳቢያ የፈረንሳይ ፖሊስ ከአንድ ሺህ በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ነዋሪዎቹ በተቃውሞው ወቅት በንብረት ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት አስመልክቶ ያላቸውን ሀዘንና ብስጭት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hiriira nagaa irraa gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramee lafa irratti miidhaan guddaan gahe irratti jiraattonni magaalaa Paaris gadda guddaa ibsaniiru. Jeequmsa fi saamicha uumameen walqabatee poolisiin Faransaay namoota kuma tokko ol to'annoo jala oolcheera. Jiraattonni magaalattiis mancaatii qabeenyaa fi jeequmsa hiriiricha keessatti raawwatamee ture irratti mufannaa guddaa qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Why have settler pogroms surged during olive harvest season in West Bank?
english: Violent attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinians and international diplomats have increased significantly during the current olive harvest season in the occupied West Bank. Although European nations have formally condemned these actions and called for accountability, critics argue that these verbal statements are ineffective as long as the settlers continue to act with impunity. The ongoing escalation represents a worsening trend of violence targeting both local communities and foreign officials, with observers urging Israel to uphold international law and stop settlement expansion.
amharic: በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ የዘይቱን ምርት በሚሰበስቡበት ወቅት በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ጨምሯል። የአውሮፓ ህብረት እና የተለያዩ ሀገራት ይህንን ጥቃት ቢኮንኑም፣ ተቺዎች እስራኤል ለፈጻሚዎቹ ተጠያቂነትን እስካላረጋገጠች ድረስ እነዚህ የቃላት ውግዘቶች ለውጥ አያመጡም ብለዋል። ይህ እየተባባሰ የመጣ የጥቃት ዘመቻ በውጭ አገር ዲፕሎማቶች እና በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን እንድታከብር ግፊት እየተደረገባት ነው።
oromo: Yeroo haamaa ejersaa amma mudachaa jiru kanatti, qe’ee qabame kan Lixaa Baanki keessatti haleellaan qubattoota Israa’el irraan gahu yeroodha gara yerootti dabalaa jira. Gamtaan Awurooppaa fi biyyoonni adda addaa haleellaa kana balaaleffataniiruus, qaamonni qeequ, Israa’el tarkaanfii seeraa osoo hin fudhatin balaaleffannaan afaani qofa bu’aa akka hin qabne ibsu. title: Nottingham Forest vs Arsenal LIVE: Premier League
english: Nottingham Forest is hosting Arsenal today at the City Ground for a Premier League match. The game is scheduled to begin at 15:30 GMT. Arsenal enters this fixture aiming for a win to keep pace with league leaders Manchester City.

title: There’s a ‘New Middle East’, but not the one Israel planned
english: Israeli officials had hoped to reshape the Middle East by expanding their territory and marginalizing the Palestinian cause. Instead, these military actions have backfired by uniting regional powers against Israel. Consequently, a new geopolitical landscape has emerged that counters Israel's original strategic vision.
amharic: የእስራኤል መሪዎች ግዛታቸውን በማስፋፋት እና የፍልስጤምን ጥያቄ በማዳከም በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አዲስ የፖለቲካ ካርታ ለመፍጠር አልመው ነበር። ሆኖም፣ እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ውጤታቸው ተቃራኒ ሆኖ በመገኘቱ፣ ክልሉ በእስራኤል ላይ እንዲተባበር አድርገውታል። በዚህም ምክንያት እስራኤል ካሰበችው በተለየ መልኩ፣ እሷን የሚቃወም አዲስ የክልል ስልታዊ አሰላለፍ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Israa'el naannawa baha giddu galeessaatti lafa isaanii babal'isuufi gaaffii filisxeemotaa ukkaamsuun sirna haaraa uumuuf karoorfatanii turan. Haa ta'u malee, tarkaanfiin waraanaa isaan fudhatan kun bu'aa faallaa fidee, biyyoonni naannichaa Israa'el irratti akka walta'an dirqisiiseera. Kanaafuu, karoora Israa'el duraanii kan faallessuufi akka ishee dura dhaabbatuuf kan gargaaru haalli siyaas-diinagdee haaraan naannichatti uumameera.

title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
english: Satellite images have revealed a large, high-end yacht featuring a 50-meter swimming pool and water slides anchored near a coastal villa used by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. Experts suggest these vessels are used by the leader and his family for recreation, highlighting a stark contrast to the severe poverty and food shortages faced by the general population. While the exact cost of the luxury boats remains unknown, their presence near the estate matches periods when the leader is absent from public view.
amharic: ሳተላይት ምስሎች የሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን በሚጠቀሙበት የባህር ዳርቻ መኖሪያ አቅራቢያ የ50 ሜትር መዋኛ ገንዳ እና የውሃ መንሸራተቻ ያለው ትልቅ የቅንጦት ጀልባ መገኘቱን ያሳያሉ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እነዚህ ጀልባዎች በመሪው እና በቤተሰባቸው ለመዝናኛነት የሚውሉ ሲሆኑ፣ ይህም በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው ሰፊ የድህነት እና የምግብ እጥረት ችግር ጋር ከፍተኛ ልዩነት አለው። የጀልባዎቹ ትክክለኛ ዋጋ ባይታወቅም፣ መገኘታቸው መሪው ከሕዝብ እይታ በተሰወሩባቸው ጊዜያት ጋር የሚገጥም ነው።
oromo: Suuroota saatalaayitii irraa akka hubatametti, doonii gurguddaa fi miidhagoo keessatti daakaa bishaan dheerina meetira 50 fi iddoo bishaan keessa itti taphatan qabu, naannoo mana jireenyaa hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un biratti mul'atee jira. Hayyoonni akka jedhanitti, dooniiwwan kun maatii hogganichaa biratti akka bashannanaatti tajaajilu; kunis haala hiyyummaa fi hanqina nyaataa cimaa ummanni biyyattii keessa jiru waliin wal bira qabamee yoo ilaalamu wal-faallaadha. Gatiin dooniiwwan kanaa beekamuu baatus, mul'achuun isaanii yeroo hogganichi beekamtii uummataa irraa fagaatee turetti wal-qabata.

title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
english: The United States is facing an escalating drug crisis driven by the widespread availability of powerful, lab-made synthetic opioids like fentanyl. These substances are increasingly being mixed with other dangerous chemicals, making them significantly more lethal and harder to reverse during an overdose. As usage rates climb, authorities are relying heavily on emergency medication like Naloxone to combat the record-breaking number of overdose deaths occurring across the country.
amharic: አሜሪካ እንደ ፌንታኒል ባሉ ኃይለኛ እና ሰው ሰራሽ አደንዛዥ ዕፆች መስፋፋት የተነሳ ከባድ የዕፅ ቀውስ እየገጠማት ነው። እነዚህ አደንዛዥ ዕፆች ከሌሎች አደገኛ ኬሚካሎች ጋር በመደባለቃቸው ለሕይወት አስጊ ከመሆናቸውም በላይ በሰውነት ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለመቀልበስ አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል። የዕፅ ተጠቃሚነት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ፣ ባለሥልጣናት የሞት አደጋን ለመቀነስ ናሎክሰን የተሰኘውን አስቸኳይ መድኃኒት በስፋት እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ameerikaan yeroo ammaa kana hanqina fi babal’ina qorichoota sammuu hadoochan kanneen akka fentaanil jedhamaniin rakkoo cimaa keessa jirti. Qorichoonni kunneen keemikaalota biroo waliin makamanii waan gurguramanif, lubbuu galaa fi balaan isaanii hammaachaa dhufeera. Namoonni hedduun sababa kanaatiin lubbuun isaanii darbaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan balaa kana ittisuuf qoricha 'Naloxone' jedhamu fayyadamuun lubbuu oolchuuf tattaaffii gochaa jira.

title: Chelsea’s injury-hit Emi Martinez will return to action ‘in a few weeks’
english: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez successfully underwent surgery after suffering a concussion and a jaw injury during a collision in a match against Everton. The 34-year-old expressed optimism about his recovery and expects to return to the pitch in a few weeks. In his absence, young goalkeeper Mike Penders will step in to cover for Chelsea during their upcoming stretch of competitive fixtures.
amharic: የቼልሲው ግብ ጠባቂ ኤሚሊያኖ ማርቲኔዝ ከኤቨርተን ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ በደረሰበት የጭንቅላት እና የመንጋጋ ጉዳት ምክንያት ቀዶ ሕክምና ተደርጎለታል። የ34 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ህክምናው በጥሩ ሁኔታ መጠናቀቁን ገልጾ፣ በጥቂት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ወደ ሜዳ እንደሚመለስ ተስፋ አድርጓል። እርሱ እስኪመለስ ድረስ ወጣቱ ግብ ጠባቂ ማይክ ፔንደርስ ለቼልሲ ተሰላፊ ሆኖ የሚጫወት ይሆናል።
oromo: Golkeeperii Chelsea Emiliano Martinez tapha Everton wajjin taasisaniin miidhaan mataa fi alangee isaa irra gahee erga qala'ee booda fayyaa ta'eera. Umriin isaa waggaa 34 kan ta'e kun, wal'aansichi milkaa'inaan xumuramuu ibsuudhaan torban muraasa keessatti gara dirree akka deebi'u ibseera. Martinez hanga deebi'utti, golkeeperiin dargaggeessi Mike Penders bakka isaa bu'ee taphachuuf qophiidha.

title: ‘No Kings’ protests spread across the US ahead of midterm elections
english: Across the United States, large crowds gathered for 'No Kings' protests to voice their opposition to President Donald Trump's perceived misuse of authority. Participants used these demonstrations to encourage citizens to participate in early voting before the upcoming midterm elections. The movement highlights growing political tension and the public's focus on electoral accountability.
amharic: በአሜሪካ በተለያዩ ከተሞች በፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የስልጣን አላግባብ አጠቃቀም ላይ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተካሂደዋል። 'ንጉሥ የለም' በሚል መሪ ቃል የተከናወኑት እነዚህ ሰልፎች፣ መራጮች በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ድምፃቸውን በቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲኖር በመጠየቅ ህዝባዊ ተሳትፎን ለማበረታታት እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: አሜሪካ ውስጥ በተካሄዱት 'No Kings' ወይም 'ነገሥታት የሉም' የተሰኙ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ላይ ቁጥራቸው ከፍተኛ የሆነ ህዝብ በመሳተፍ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ስልጣናቸውን አላግባብ እየተጠቀሙ ነው በማለት ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ ህዝቡ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ቀድመው ድምፃቸውን እንዲሰጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ እና መራጮች በምርጫ ሂደት ላይ ንቁ ተሳትፎ እንዲኖራቸው ለማበረታታት ያለመ ነው።

title: ‘Young protesters across Europe share grievances and tactics’
english: Young people across several European nations, including France, Italy, Belgium, and Albania, are organizing protests to voice their shared frustrations. Experts observe that these demonstrations stem from a growing sense among students that their future is being ignored by current leadership. By sharing common grievances and organizing tactics, these youth movements are demanding greater recognition and consideration for their generation.
amharic: እንደ ፈረንሳይ፣ ጣሊያን፣ ቤልጂየም እና አልባኒያ ባሉ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ወጣቶች የጋራ ቅሬታቸውን ለማሰማት ሰላማዊ ሰልፎችን እያደረጉ ነው። የፖሊሲ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ተማሪዎች የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታቸው በአመራሮቹ ዘንድ እየተዘነጋ እንደሆነ ይሰማቸዋል። ወጣቶቹ ስልቶቻቸውን በመቀናጀት እና ተመሳሳይ ጥያቄዎችን በማንሳት ለትውልዳቸው ተገቢውን ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Dargaggoonni biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen akka Faransaay, Xaaliyaanii, Beljiyeem fi Albaaniyaa keessa jiraatan, komii isanii waloon ibsachuuf hiriira ba'aa jiru. Akka ogeeyyiin siyaasaa jedhanitti, hiriirri kun kan maddise barattoonni gara fuulduraa isaanii mootummootaan akka tuffatame itti dhaga'amu irraayyi. Dargaggoonni kun mala qabsoo wal jijjiirrachuudhaan fi rakkoowwan waloo qaban kaasuun, dhaloota isaaniif xiyyeeffannoon akka kennamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Photos: Protests across France spiral into looting, blazes and clashes
english: Massive protests against the high cost of living and poor school conditions across France recently descended into widespread violence, looting, and arson. Authorities have arrested approximately 1,200 individuals, while 150 police officers sustained injuries during clashes in major cities. President Macron has condemned the destruction of public property and vowed that those involved in the unrest will face legal consequences.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነትን እና በትምህርት ቤቶች ያለው የከፋ ሁኔታ በመቃወም በተደረጉ ሰልፎች ከፍተኛ ሁከት፣ ዝርፊያ እና የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት በአገሪቱ በተለያዩ ከተሞች በተደረጉ ግጭቶች 1,200 ሰዎች ታስረው 150 የፖሊስ አባላት ቆስለዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ማክሮን በሕዝብ ንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ አካላት በሕግ እንደሚጠየቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti mormii gatii jireenyaa olka’uu fi haala barnootaa irratti fuulleffate gara jeequmsaa, saamichaa fi gubatii qabeenyaatti jijjiiramee jira. Humnoonni nageenyaa namoota 1,200 ol to’annaa jala oolchanii jiru, akkasumas poolisoonni 150 ol miidhamanii jiru. Preezdaant Maakroon miidhaa qabeenya ummataa irratti qaqqabe balaaleffachuun, kanneen jeequmsa kana keessatti hirmaatan hundi seeraan akka gaafataman dubbatanii jiru.

title: There is no split in MAGA
english: Despite rumors of a fracture within the MAGA coalition, the movement remains united in its core values. The author argues that instead of splitting, the group is facing an intentional effort by political elites to redefine its identity. This shift incorporates hawkish, pro-war ideologies that contradict the movement's original focus on peace and challenging the establishment.
amharic: የማጋ (MAGA) ጥምረት ተከፋፍሏል የሚለው ወሬ መሰረት የለውም፣ ይልቁንም ንቅናቄው አሁንም እንደተዋሃደ ነው። ጸሐፊው እንደሚሉት፣ ችግሩ የቡድኑ መከፋፈል ሳይሆን፣ የፖለቲካ ልሂቃን የንቅናቄውን መርህ ለመቀየር የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ነው። ይህ ለውጥ የቀድሞውን የሰላም እና የመንግስት አስተዳደርን የመቃወም መርህ በመተካት ወደ ጦርነት አቀንቃኝ አስተሳሰብ እንዲያዘነብል እያደረገው ነው።
oromo: Hiriirri MAGA jedhamu cabee jira kan jedhamu dhugaarraa kan fagaatedha; gareen kun ammas tokkummaa isaa eeggatee jira. Barreessaan akka jedhutti, rakkoon jiru gareen kun gargar ba'uu utuu hin taane, qaamoleen siyaasaa dhaabbaticha jijjiiruuf carraaqaat jiru. Jijjiirraan kun immoo imala jalqabaa kan nagaa fi mormii mootummaarraa gara ilaalcha waraanaatti goruu akka qabuufi taasisaa jira.

title: Egyptian parliament to discuss defensive aid to Saudi Arabia
english: The Egyptian parliament is convening an emergency session to debate President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi's proposal to provide defensive military support to Saudi Arabia. While the President emphasized that Egypt is committed to protecting its ally, he clarified that any potential assistance would be limited strictly to defensive measures. Lawmakers are meeting to decide whether to officially authorize this request.
